_about: Doctrine topics and the teachings filed under each. Key = post id. "topics": main topic first. "theme" groups teachings inside the main topic. "teaching": false leaves a post out. Edit freely; clean_studies.py reads this on every run.

topics.about: Men given over by God after they reject Him: Romans 1, hardened hearts, and knowing them by their fruits.

topics.name: God, Christ & the Holy Ghost
topics.about: The one true God, the deity of Christ, and the Comforter.

topics.name: The Word of God
topics.about: The KJV, the preservation of scripture, and rightly dividing it.

topics.name: The local church
topics.about: The church Christ founded, the pastor, and assembling together.

topics.name: Baptist history
topics.about: The line of believers and the Baptist distinctives through history: history to learn from, not another system to be married to.

topics.name: Soul winning & the gospel
topics.about: Preaching the gospel to every creature.

topics.name: The Christian walk
topics.about: Separation, service, and walking with God.

topics.name: Trusting God in trouble
topics.about: Affliction, comfort, and waiting on the Lord.

topics.name: Prayer, praise & worship
topics.about: How to pray, vows, and praise.

topics.about: Proverbs and the wisdom that leads to Christ.

topics.name: Marriage, family & the home
topics.about: Husbands, wives, children and honouring parents.

topics.name: The law & the covenants
topics.about: What the law is for, and the covenants of God.

topics.name: Christ in the Old Testament
topics.about: Types, shadows and prophecies fulfilled in Christ.

topics.name: Israel & the Israel of God
topics.about: Who Israel is, the church, and Zionism.

topics.name: End times & prophecy
topics.about: Post-tribulation, pre-wrath: Christ gathers His saints after the tribulation and before God's wrath is poured out.

topics.name: Judgment, hell & the resurrection
topics.about: The judgment seat, the end of the wicked, and today as the day of salvation.

topics.about: False gospels, false prophets and false churches.

topics.about: God's judgment on nations, and the believer in them.

topics.about: The heavens declare the glory of God.

6543.title: Abel's blood sacrifice and Cain's works
6543.summary: Abel was accepted by faith in the blood sacrifice while Cain was rejected for offering his own works, and the shedding of innocent blood cries out from the earth and brings judgment on a land.

7342.title: The hosts of angels about Jacob
7342.summary: God sets His angels over the saved to protect and guide them, yet like Jacob we still scheme in our own strength when our real battle is with God and our vow to serve Him.

10369.title: Immanuel, God with us
10369.summary: The merciful God who knows His people by name is present with them always, as promised throughout the Old and New Testaments.

12390.title: God is a God of separation
12390.summary: From creation onward God separates and divides to make a holy people, separating believing Israel after the Spirit from unbelieving Israel after the flesh, wheat from chaff, until the harvest is complete.

12922.title: Why the law cannot save
12922.summary: Keeping God's law is for our good but not for salvation, since no one can keep it all; the law is a schoolmaster bringing us to Christ to be justified freely by grace through faith.

13806.title: The evil of sodomites given free reign
13806.summary: The Gibeah outrage parallels Sodom to show the evil of a nation allowing sodomites free reign, which God's law calls an abomination worthy of death.

14861.title: The prayer of Jabez answered
14861.summary: Like Jabez, those who abide in Christ and come to God in faith can ask boldly according to His will and be heard.

16748.title: A pastor is worthy of his hire
16748.summary: Like Nehemiah and Paul, a pastor may rightly be supported by tithes for his living but must not use the ministry to get rich off the flock.

17674.theme: After the tribulation, before the wrath
17674.title: Psalm 7 and the day of the Lord
17674.summary: Psalm 7 prophesies the day of the Lord, when after the tribulation Christ returns and the resurrected and living saints are caught up to compass Him about in the air before the wrath.

17706.title: Words are the window to the heart
17706.summary: The righteous are vexed by the wicked words of the world, and as Jesus taught, what comes out of the mouth reveals and defiles the heart, so believers must watch what they say.

17751.title: My God, why hast thou forsaken me
17751.summary: Psalm 22 prophetically gives Christ's cry from the cross, when bearing the sin of all mankind as our scapegoat and High Priest He was forsaken by the Father that we might live.

17784.title: Seek His face in prayer
17784.summary: As David modeled, believers are commanded to seek God's face in faith and prayer, confessing sin and trusting His faithfulness and deliverance through trouble.

17835.title: Not a bone of Him broken
17835.summary: Psalm 34's unbroken bones, fulfilled at the cross and pictured in the Passover lamb, show that all scripture points to Jesus and that God keeps His prophetic promises.

17855.title: David's repentance versus Cain's sorrow
17855.summary: Unlike Cain, who only grieved his punishment, David as a saved man grieves his sin itself, and confession and a plea for mercy are the only way out of the Lord's chastening.

17889.title: Hope thou in God
17889.summary: In the spiritual siege believers face from a hostile world, God promises to draw nigh to those who turn to Him in humility, so we can hope in Him and praise Him with confidence.

17936.theme: Christ our King and High Priest
17936.title: Myrrh, aloes and cassia on the King
17936.summary: The spices on the King's garments in Psalm 45 picture the gospel: myrrh His sacrificial death, aloes His incorruption and resurrection, and cassia His ascension and eternal priesthood.

17971.theme: The church is the Israel of God
17971.title: Zion, the redeemed bride of Christ
17971.summary: Zion and Jerusalem are a picture of the believer, the redeemed bride of Christ whom He jealously protects and will perfect as the New Jerusalem.

17987.title: Dark sayings made plain in Christ
17987.summary: Parables and dark sayings filter the humble from the spiritually blind, but Christ opened all the Old Testament to show it points to Him, and the Spirit now reveals its meaning to believers.

18021.title: Our flesh sins, not the new man
18021.summary: Honest confession brings forgiveness through Christ's blood, and sin is not imputed to the believer because it is the flesh that sins, not the new man born of God.

17197.title: Rich yet nothing, poor yet rich
17197.summary: Wealth itself is not sin, but true riches are being poor in spirit and content in Christ, and what matters is the spirit of a man and what he does with what he has.

17256.title: The Lord pondereth the hearts
17256.summary: God ordains rulers and directs the king's heart, and He judges the spirit behind men's deeds, valuing mercy and judgment over sacrifice, so the sacrifice of the wicked is abomination.

17394.title: Honour includes supporting your parents
17394.summary: Biblical honour carries financial weight, so the command to honour father and mother includes children providing for their parents, just as we honour the Lord with tithes.

17410.theme: Every word of God is pure
17410.title: Every word of God is pure
17410.summary: Because every word of God is pure and must not be added to or taken from, we need an every-word Bible, which God has preserved in English in the Authorized Version.

17523.title: The limits of Solomon's wisdom
17523.summary: Even Solomon's great wisdom could not find out all the ways of God, which are known only as God gives wisdom by His Spirit to those who seek Him.

15688.title: The kingdom taken from Saul, given to David
15688.summary: Isaiah 9 is paired with the Samuel accounts of victory spoil and of the kingdom taken from Saul and established forever in David's house.

11604.theme: The church is the Israel of God
11604.title: Circumcise your hearts, O Jerusalem
11604.summary: God called Judah to repent with a circumcision of the heart by faith rather than of the flesh, but they were a stiff-necked people whose destruction was their own doing.

12057.title: Honouring parents means caring for them
12057.summary: Honouring parents means obeying them in all things not against God's law and caring for them in old age, which the Lord takes so seriously that He condemned the Pharisees' Corban loophole.

16442.theme: The new heavens and new earth
16442.title: Ezekiel's temple as what could have been
16442.summary: Ezekiel's temple may be read as what could have been, since God with foreknowledge set conditional promises before Israel under the Mosaic covenant, which they failed to keep.

15482.title: Heap coals of fire on his head
15482.summary: Unlike Jonah, believers must show mercy to enemies, including giving them the bread of life and water of the gospel, remembering the mercy God showed them.

5202.title: Trent's anathema on faith alone
5202.summary: The Council of Trent's curse on justification by faith alone puts the Catholic Church against the Bible, which teaches salvation by grace through faith without works.

10782.title: Righteousness by faith, not circumcision
10782.summary: Abraham was counted righteous by faith before circumcision, so no rite, baptism, or work is required for salvation, and the inheritance is by faith in Christ, not by fleshly descent as Zionism and dispensationalism claim.

6546.title: Then began men to call upon the name of the Lord
6546.summary: Since the generation of Enos all men have been saved the same way, by faith in the Lord, calling upon His name, as Romans 10:13 and Joel 2:32 declare.

7343.title: Pay thy vows and plead His promises
7343.summary: God holds us to the vows we make in His name, yet He delights when we remind Him of His promises in prayer, and in Christ we have boldness and access to ask of the Father.

10503.title: Beginning each day as the Lord's first fruits
10503.summary: As the tabernacle was reared on the first day of the first month and the firstfruits belong to God, the believer gives himself to God daily, washed in Christ's blood and sanctified by the Spirit through his walk.

12404.title: The camps of Israel and the throne of God
12404.summary: The four standards of Israel's camps around the tabernacle mirror the four living creatures around God's throne in Ezekiel and Revelation, because the tabernacle was made after the pattern of the things in heaven.

13115.title: Nations judged for shedding innocent blood
13115.summary: A nation that refuses to punish those who shed innocent blood, whether by repealing capital punishment, funding abortion or bombing innocents, is guilty of that blood and God will judge it, so believers must stand against it.

13946.title: Obedient sons of a heavenly Father
13946.summary: The repeated failure of godly fathers to raise godly sons shows the need for faithful multigenerational families under God, and Christ the obedient Son is our model for honoring our Father as adopted children rather than children of wrath.

14907.title: He that is chief, as he that doth serve
14907.summary: Like David's mighty men and the disciples striving for position, believers may strive to do great things for the Lord, but first must seek to serve, counting the cost of suffering while pressing toward the prize.

16843.title: Job and the hedge of protection
16843.summary: Job shows that both wealth and affliction are to God's glory, refuting both the idea that only the wicked prosper and the prosperity gospel, while Satan, the god of this world, works only within what God allows.

17684.title: Jesus is the excellent name of the Lord
17684.summary: Psalm 8 praises Christ, who is God, the Creator through whom all things were made, the I AM given the name above every name, and the only name under heaven by which men must be saved and worshipped.

17708.title: Pure words preserved for ever
17708.summary: God inspired His word and promised in Psalm 12 to preserve it pure for every generation, and the King James Bible is that purified, every-word English Bible without error, refined after six earlier English versions.

17753.title: Psalm 22 and the sufferings of the cross
17753.summary: Psalm 22 prophetically pictures the mockery, piercing, thirst and parted garments of Christ's crucifixion and the anguish He bore all His life, before turning to the hope that all things work together for good to them that love God.

17802.title: Loving the truth and hating every false way
17802.summary: David's psalms of trust are models of prayer that Christ Himself quoted, and loving God's truth, a gift of the Spirit, means hating false prophets who teach damnable heresy while loving those they mislead enough to tell them the truth.

17843.title: Pray to God against them that persecute us
17843.summary: Believers may pray as David did for deliverance and against enemies who seek their hurt, asking God to send His angels to defend them, but must pray only to God and never to angels as false teachers lead people to do.

17868.title: A new song of His great salvation
17868.summary: Psalm 40 rejoices in God's deliverance from the miry pit of sin onto the rock Christ, showing that God never required sacrifices to save but only faith in His promises, which comes by hearing His word and calling on His name.

17924.title: Counted as sheep for the slaughter
17924.summary: The lament of Psalm 44 is turned into instruction in Romans 8 that nothing can separate us from Christ's love, and believers grown weak by comfort must be prepared to endure persecution, even the coming tribulation, without losing faith.

17946.title: Forget thy father's house: the bride of the King
17946.summary: Psalm 45 pictures believers as the bride of Christ, called to love Him above family and nation as a wife leaves her parents, and to look not to earthly lineage but to the spiritual children they win to the gospel.

17974.title: The promise was to Abraham's seed, which is Christ
17974.summary: The promise to Abraham was made to his seed Christ and to all who are in Christ, the land promise was fulfilled under Joshua and kept conditionally under the Mosaic covenant, so Zionism wrongly gives the inheritance to unbelieving Jews.

17990.theme: After the tribulation, before the wrath
17990.title: Gather my saints together unto me
17990.summary: Psalm 50, a prophecy of Asaph the seer in God's own voice, shows Christ the Creator returning in fire to judge, and the gathering of His saints before His wrath is poured out, proving the rapture is no new doctrine.

18025.title: God shall likewise destroy thee for ever
18025.summary: The boastful wicked who reject the fear of the Lord face eternal torment in hell, and believers should name them plainly and preach that hard truth so some may be pulled out of the fire.

17215.title: The Lord hath made all things for himself
17215.summary: God judges the spirit behind men's deeds and uses even the wicked, like Assyria, for His purposes, so we should commit our works to Him and walk in the fear of the Lord, which brings wisdom and makes even our enemies be at peace with us.

17281.title: Be not envious against evil men
17281.summary: Solomon's later proverbs read like Paul's epistles in teaching believers not to envy or keep company with evil men nor partake of their sins, showing the single unified wisdom of God throughout the Bible.

17395.title: Honour thy parents, not the tradition of men
17395.summary: Jesus upheld the commandment to honor father and mother against the Pharisees' Corban tradition, and a generation that abandoned its parents to the state and its children to schools has broken God's multigenerational family order and reaped suffering.

17435.title: Who can find a virtuous woman
17435.summary: The virtuous woman of Proverbs 31 is God's ideal wife, trustworthy, diligent, enterprising, generous, wise and never idle, a gift of God to her husband who becomes so by fearing the Lord and following His ways.

17543.theme: Now is the day of salvation
17543.title: Remember thy Creator before it is too late
17543.summary: Solomon's conclusion that all is vanity calls men to remember their Creator now, before death or the darkened sun of the day of the Lord, when it will be too late to fear Him.

15706.title: The burden of Babylon and the day of His wrath
15706.summary: Isaiah's prophecy against Babylon has a dual fulfillment, in the fall of the Babylonian empire and in the destruction of the spirit of Babylon in the wrath to come, when no silver or gold can deliver.

11667.title: Bloom where the Lord has planted you
11667.summary: Like Jeremiah, who longed to flee to the wilderness but was sent to preach at the temple gates, Christians are not to retreat to compounds but to be a light where people are, enduring tribulation with hope because Christ has overcome the world.

12058.title: Easy-believism and the strait gate
12058.summary: Salvation by believing on Christ alone, mocked as easy-believism, is the strait gate few find, because pride, works and the false hope of repent-of-your-sins preachers keep men from simply trusting that Jesus paid it all.

15287.theme: Now is the day of salvation
15287.title: Seek the Lord while he may be found
15287.summary: God is longsuffering, but there comes a point when He withdraws Himself from a nation or an individual and they become reprobate, so men must seek Him now while He may be found.

16516.title: Not by might, but by my Spirit
16516.summary: Zechariah's golden candlestick fed by two olive trees shows that the temple is restored by God's Spirit, with lamp oil picturing the Holy Ghost, the olive trees the two witnesses of Revelation, and the candlesticks the churches.

5614.title: The crucifixion foretold in Isaiah 53 and Psalm 22
5614.summary: The scourging, mocking, parted garments and cry of forsaking at Christ's crucifixion fulfilled Isaiah 53 and Psalm 22 as the obedient Son did His Father's will.

10838.title: Predestinated in Christ, not chosen to believe
10838.summary: Predestination in Ephesians 1 and Romans 8 is in Christ, not God choosing who will believe, since God will have all men to be saved and draws all men, so Calvinism and limited atonement are doctrines of devils rooted in pride.

6558.title: Enoch walked with God
6558.summary: Enoch, translated by faith and prophet of Christ's coming, is the example of walking separated and pleasing God, and the patriarchs picture the steps of coming to Christ.

7657.title: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah
7657.summary: Jacob's dying blessings show the consequences of his sons' sins, and Judah receives the promise of Christ, the Lion of Judah and Shiloh who rode in on the ass's colt.

11255.title: Not every calamity is judgment for sin
11255.summary: Some things happen by time and chance or simply for God's glory, so believers should not read every misfortune as punishment but make peace with God's will and live to glorify Him.

12466.title: Should New Testament Christians take vows
12466.summary: Christ and James command not to swear, so believers should live consecrated lives daily without vows, keeping an honest testimony as a witness for the gospel.

13160.title: Don't make a vow you cannot keep
13160.summary: God will exact the price of any vow made in His name, so it is no sin to refuse to vow, and plain honesty with yea and nay is the better way.

14236.title: Secret sin and the Father's rod
14236.summary: God chastens His adopted children and brings secret sins to light, and the guilt of conscience should drive the believer to confess and forsake sin.

14937.title: When family despises your walk with Christ
14937.summary: As Michal despised David's worship, worldly loved ones may resent a believer's walk with Christ, and Jesus warns that family and the cares of this world must not come before discipleship.

16936.title: The wicked prosper, then the grave
16936.summary: Though the wicked may live long and prosper, they are reserved for the day of wrath and the Great White Throne judgment.

17685.title: Jerusalem, where God placed His name
17685.summary: Jerusalem and Mount Moriah, where God chose to place His name and provided the ram for Isaac, point to Christ, the name God placed there to be sacrificed and to reign.

17711.title: Waiting on God's perfect timing
17711.summary: Impatient waiting in trials should give way to remembering God's bountiful dealing and salvation, since patience in waiting on the Lord renews strength and builds godliness.

17755.title: Not forsaking the assembling together
17755.summary: Fellowship, preaching, testimony and exhortation in the congregation strengthen believers in trial and teach the doctrine from which praise and the fear of the Lord come.

17810.title: Blessed is the man whose sin is covered
17810.summary: As David and Paul teach, God imputes righteousness without works and does not hold the believer's sins against him, and this good news must be received today before God's Spirit ceases to strive.

17848.title: The fear of God divides wicked and righteous
17848.summary: The wicked, without fear of God, flatter themselves in pride and love iniquity and end in hell, while those who fear God receive His mercy, protection and imputed righteousness.

17874.title: Blessed is he that considereth the poor
17874.summary: God blesses those who help the poor out of unfeigned charity rather than to be seen, because the heart behind the giving is what He rewards.

17932.title: Psalm 45 and the conquering King
17932.summary: Psalm 45, inspired by the Holy Ghost, prophesies Christ the bridegroom King whose truth, meekness and righteousness are the qualities believers should pursue.

17950.title: God is our refuge and strength
17950.summary: The scriptures' promises of God as refuge and fortress are real expressions of faith forged in trouble, kept by the gift of His Son and witnessed by the Spirit of adoption.

17975.theme: The church is the Israel of God
17975.title: The inheritance belongs to all in Christ
17975.summary: The land promise is fulfilled in the resurrection and the inheritance passes to all who have put on Christ, so Christians who give it away to modern Zionism for politics are like Esau selling his birthright.

17991.title: The blood of the covenant and thanksgiving
17991.summary: The Old Covenant sacrifices sealed in blood pictured Christ's once-for-all sacrifice, and God never needed them but desires thanksgiving, mercy and right judgment.

17180.title: Wisdom's feast and the gospel invitation
17180.summary: Wisdom's feast pictures the gospel invitation in which Christ the bread of life calls all, simple and wise, good and bad, to come and freely take the water of life.

17235.title: Death and life in the power of the tongue
17235.summary: Proverbs teaches that men are judged by their words, that offended brothers are hard to win, and that Jesus is the friend who sticks closer than a brother.

17285.title: Deliver them that are drawn unto death
17285.summary: Every man is judged by his works, believers at the bema seat for reward and the lost at the Great White Throne, so a believer who fails to give the gospel to the perishing cannot plead ignorance and will suffer loss.

17396.title: Obedience modeled by the Son
17396.summary: Christ's obedience to the Father is the example for believers, and learning to fear and honor parents is where the fear of the Lord begins.

17482.title: Two are better than one
17482.summary: Solomon shows the world's oppressed and oppressors have no comforter, but believers have the Comforter and Christ who bears their load and gives rest.

17572.title: Thou art all fair, my love
17572.summary: The bride seen without blemish pictures believers made righteous and unblameable in Christ, and the sealed garden pictures eternal security.

15778.title: Precept upon precept on the cornerstone
15778.summary: Jesus is the rejected stone made the head of the corner, the only foundation, and believers grow line upon line building works on Him that will be tried at judgment.

11721.title: If thou hast run with the footmen
11721.summary: Believers should not envy the prospering wicked or complain over small troubles, but grow faith that does not fear, knowing God delivers and vengeance is His.

12266.theme: A line of faith since Abel
12266.title: A trail of blood of believers
12266.summary: Saved believers stand in an unbroken line of faith, bearing fruit after its kind from Abel through the apostles to today, linked by a trail of martyrs' blood persecuted by Rome and the false church.

15314.title: God desires mercy, not sacrifice
15314.summary: Sacrifices were always for man's benefit, pointing to Christ's once-for-all offering, and God desires obedience, confession and mercy toward others.

16532.title: Playing church versus mercy
16532.summary: God is not pleased with outward acts of religion, ritual and showy worship but with a humble heart and mercy to the lost, the poor and the widow.

12761.title: The work of the Holy Ghost
12761.summary: The Holy Ghost quickens, indwells, comforts and seals believers unto redemption, bears witness that they are God's children, reproves the world, teaches the word and makes intercession.

13365.title: Patience in tribulation
13365.summary: Scripture repeatedly teaches believers to wait on the Lord with patience and courage, not fearing tribulation, because God will surely deliver in the end.

6760.title: Abraham believed God and was counted righteous
6760.summary: Like Abraham, whose belief in God's promise was imputed to him for righteousness, salvation has always been by hearing and believing God's word, by faith alone and not by works.

10263.title: The tabernacle, a pattern of heavenly things
10263.summary: Every part of the tabernacle is a picture of Christ and the Christian life: the freewill offering of accepting the gospel, the ark as the covenant written on our hearts, the shewbread as God's word, and the candlestick as the light of Christ.

11341.theme: Christ our King and High Priest
11341.title: The veil rent: come boldly to the throne
11341.summary: The high priest entered behind the veil only once a year, but Christ's death rent the veil, so believers may come boldly before God at any time through Christ our high priest.

12875.title: Glimpses from the mountaintop
12875.summary: Like Moses seeing the land he would not enter, believers may not see the fruit of their labours in this life, but trusting the Lord and hoping in our redemption gives patience to wait on His promises.

13319.title: Rahab and the scarlet thread
13319.summary: Rahab the harlot was saved by her faith in God and placed in the line of Christ, her scarlet thread a picture of His blood, showing God can redeem anyone who holds the faith.

14406.theme: Christ the foundation of the church
14406.title: Upon this rock I will build my church
14406.summary: Posted with the building of Solomon's temple, the verses set out that the church is built on Christ, the only foundation, and that the mountain of the Lord's house shall be exalted and all nations flow to it.

15143.title: Seek the Lord and He gives rest
15143.summary: God promises to reward those who diligently seek Him and will answer prayers asked according to His will, in His time and as we need, so we simply have to trust Him.

16980.title: Jesus the vein of wisdom
16980.summary: Wisdom is worth more than gold or rubies, begins with the fear of the Lord, and all its treasures are hid in Christ.

17700.title: Defend the widow and the fatherless
17700.summary: God's call to defend and provide for the widow, the fatherless and the needy is the outward practice He expects of believers, and He desires this mercy rather than the vain rituals and sacrifices of works-based religion.

17720.title: Delight in the saints, not Lordship salvation
17720.summary: Calling Jesus Lord is a saved believer's statement of fact, not the false gospel of Lordship salvation; our good works add nothing to God but are poured out in love and service to the saints.

17760.title: The Lord is my shepherd in this life
17760.summary: Psalm 23's promises are not automatic for all the dead but belong to believers by faith in Jesus the Good Shepherd, who supplies every need and gives peace and comfort in this life's valleys.

17812.title: Transgression, sin and iniquity forgiven
17812.summary: Transgression is wilful rebellion, sin is missing the mark and iniquity is our twisted nature, and on the cross Christ bore all three, imputing His righteousness to believers so they are found not guilty, past, present and future.

17851.title: Ye are the salt of the earth
17851.summary: People are saved by faith alone, but nations are judged by Christians' works, so America's decline comes from believers losing their savour and not turning from wickedness, which is not persecution for righteousness' sake.

17877.title: A friend that sticketh closer than a brother
17877.summary: When friends and even family betray us at our lowest, as Judas betrayed Christ in fulfilment of Psalm 41, Jesus understands and will never leave nor forsake us.

17934.title: Anointed with the oil of gladness
17934.summary: The anointing of the king in Psalm 45 pictures Jesus anointed by the Spirit without measure, exalted after the cross, who gives believers the anointing of the Spirit by faith.

17966.theme: After the tribulation, before the wrath
17966.title: Christ the King of all the earth
17966.summary: Psalm 47 prophesies Jesus, who is God, ascending with a shout and returning with a trumpet to catch up the saints, reign as King of kings over every nation, and finally deliver the kingdom to the Father.

17977.theme: God the refuge of His people
17977.title: God known in her palaces for a refuge
17977.summary: God's promise to be a refuge for His people and make their enemies flee is shown in Joshua's victory over the five kings and David's taking of Zion.

17993.title: The charge of formalism
17993.summary: As God indicted Israel for keeping outward forms while failing to declare His law and show mercy, Christians covered by Christ's once-for-all sacrifice must not be hypocrites but do the good works they were saved for.

17184.title: The wise son and the diligent hand
17184.summary: Proverbs contrasts the diligent, righteous and wise with the lazy fool; God provides for those who work, and the wise gather the harvest, including winning souls.

17239.title: Chasten thy son while there is hope
17239.summary: Parents should chasten their children early as the Father chastens us, to instil the fear of the Lord, and children must honour father and mother, including caring for them in old age, a command God backed with death in the law.

17374.title: Usury and the Lord's release
17374.summary: In the King James Bible usury is any interest on a loan, and God's law of the seventh-year release, the jubilee and no usury to the poor kept the needy from bondage, picturing redemption in Christ.

17398.title: Stiff necks and the hated upright
17398.summary: Those who harden their necks against reproof come to destruction without remedy, and the wicked hate the righteous because they hate Christ and the light that exposes their evil.

17489.title: Better not to vow than not to pay
17489.summary: God takes vows seriously and wants sincere prayer and humble service, not rash vows, long showy prayers or boasting of works to be seen of men.

17577.title: The bride who would not open
17577.summary: The bride who delayed to open to her beloved pictures saved believers who grow complacent and make excuses when God calls them to His work, and so lose His fellowship and suffer His chastening.

15880.title: I am the LORD, there is none else
15880.summary: God's specific prophecy of Cyrus proves He alone is God and that His promise of salvation in Christ is just as sure, and the Israel that shall be saved is all who are Abraham's seed by faith in Christ.

11931.title: Never be ashamed to preach the word
11931.summary: As the Jews threatened the prophets and killed Christ, the world will hate Christians who preach God's word, but we must boldly share the gospel and never be ashamed of it.

16262.title: Reprobate silver: Jerusalem as dross
16262.summary: Jerusalem broke the old covenant through idolatry, false prophets and oppressing the poor, despised God's longsuffering, and was judged and cast out like dross, which is why a new covenant was needed.

15327.theme: The church is the Israel of God
15327.title: A remnant according to the election of grace
15327.summary: God saves or condemns by belief and unbelief, not ethnicity or nation: Israel's branches were broken off for unbelief, Gentiles are grafted in by faith, and God's children are Abraham's seed by faith.

16617.title: Thirty pieces of silver cast to the potter
16617.summary: Zechariah 11 prophesies judgment on Judah's false shepherds and the breaking of the covenant, and his price of thirty pieces of silver cast to the potter is fulfilled in Judas' betrayal of the Good Shepherd.

10660.title: Study to shew thyself approved
10660.summary: Paul's writings are scripture that the unlearned wrest to their destruction, so believers must study and rightly divide the word, comparing scripture with scripture, to guard against false doctrine.

8698.title: His mercies are new every morning
8698.summary: A saved believer still carrying guilt should believe God's irrevocable promise that his sins are blotted out and remembered no more, and that it is never too late to turn back to the Father, whose mercies are new every morning.

7252.title: Forgiveness is not earned by penance
7252.summary: Like Esau compounding his trespass to regain favor, we cannot earn forgiveness by penance; God forgives by grace and mercy those who sincerely confess and turn, as the prodigal son did.

10346.title: The sabbath, a picture of rest in Christ
10346.summary: The sabbath pictures resting in Christ's finished work, so salvation is by faith alone, and keeping the seventh-day sabbath to be saved, as Seventh-day Adventists do, is judaized bondage while Christians gather on the Lord's day.

7745.title: How to increase your faith
7745.summary: Faith grows by hearing the word, doing it, praying for faith, and obeying God in things like church and tithing so that His kept promises teach us to trust Him more.

12921.title: Teach them diligently unto thy children
12921.summary: Parents are commanded to diligently teach their children God's word, discipline them with the rod as a picture of the Father's loving chastening, and above all live an example of His grace.

13519.title: Not one word of His promise has failed
13519.summary: As every promise to Israel came to pass, all God's promises in Christ are sure, giving believers rest and assurance and moving them to cleanse themselves and draw others to Christ.

14433.title: Seek ye first the kingdom of God
14433.summary: Solomon building God's house before his own shows that those who seek God's kingdom first are blessed, not with a prosperity gospel but with fellowship and reward, as pillars in Christ's temple.

16745.title: Building the wall while the mockers scoff
16745.summary: Like Nehemiah's builders, believers growing in sanctification will be mocked even by family, and must keep building, put on the whole armour of God, and pray for one another.

17645.theme: Christ our King and High Priest
17645.title: Why do the heathen rage
17645.summary: Psalm 2 prophesies the rulers' vain rebellion against God's anointed, whom God raised up and set as King over the nations, warning rulers to kiss the Son and trust in Him.

17702.title: If the foundations be destroyed
17702.summary: Believers need not fear or flee from the wicked, even in the Tribulation, because Christ is risen and is the sure foundation, while the wicked will drink the cup of God's wrath.

17735.title: The heavens declare the glory of God
17735.summary: Creation and conscience reveal God's power and law to all men so that they are without excuse, while His written word gives the hope of mercy and leads to salvation.

17764.title: Righteousness from the God of our salvation
17764.summary: Believers are made clean by God's imputed righteousness received by faith, not by their own works, and Roman Catholicism's denial of imputation at the Council of Trent is a lie.

17834.title: No want to them that fear Him
17834.summary: God provides for those who fear Him and live righteously, chastens those who do not, and expects believers to love the brethren by not forsaking the assembling of the local church.

17852.title: The desires of thine heart
17852.summary: When we trust the Lord and do good, our heart's desires become His, turning from our own lusts to pure religion and good works done for others so they glorify God.

17880.title: As the hart panteth after the water brooks
17880.summary: Even mature believers can be downcast and mocked in trials, but troubles strengthen faith, and the hope of the living water in Christ never leaves us ashamed.

17935.title: Thou art the Christ
17935.summary: The title Christ was a loaded term for the anointed deliverer the Jews expected, and believing that Jesus is the Christ is what is required to be born of God.

17969.theme: The church is the Israel of God
17969.title: Mount Zion, chosen of God
17969.summary: Zion is holy because God placed His name there and separated it for His purposes, the place of Christ's sacrifice and future reign, not because its people are holy.

17985.title: The vanity of riches before death
17985.summary: Wise and fool, rich and poor all die, riches cannot ransom a soul, and only the fear of the Lord and redemption through Christ give hope in the day of wrath.

18011.title: David's cry of contrition
18011.summary: Psalm 51 shows how a believer under God's judgment should come in humble worship and confession, trusting that God is faithful to forgive and cleanse even sins like David's.

17192.title: The root of the righteous shall not be moved
17192.summary: Proverbs carries a consistent gospel message: a man is made good by faith that comes by the word, and the root of righteousness is Christ, not Israel as dispensationalists claim nor Peter as Catholics claim.

17253.title: Remaining in the congregation of the dead
17253.summary: Those who see the way of truth but reject it without truly believing are given over by God to a reprobate mind and cannot be brought again to repentance.

17375.title: Usury and forgiving our debtors
17375.summary: God's people should not take usury or unjust gain from the poor but give cheerfully and forgive debts, as God has forgiven us.

17403.title: The fool uttereth all his mind
17403.summary: Proverbs 29 teaches restraint of speech, that all men share one end so we should seek the eternal in Christ, and that children raised without the rod and fear of the Lord multiply the wicked as foretold for the last days.

17515.title: Wisdom maketh his face to shine
17515.summary: Walking with God and being anointed by the Spirit changes a believer's countenance and gives boldness to preach the truth, so that others see they have been with Jesus.

17585.title: I am my beloved's
17585.summary: The bride's choice to rise early and go forth with her beloved pictures the mature believer deliberately making Christ the centre of each day and working with Him to bear fruit in new believers.

15991.theme: The new heavens and new earth
15991.title: To Him did all prophets give witness
15991.summary: Isaiah 66, quoted throughout the New Testament, encapsulates the believer's hope of a new heaven and earth, Christ's judgment of the wicked, and rest for those who trust Him.

11963.title: Peace, peace, when there is no peace
11963.summary: False prophets preach peace, prosperity and a pre-tribulation escape to itching ears, but true preachers warn of judgment and call men to repent and find peace only in Christ.

16334.title: We have Abraham to our father
16334.summary: The claim that the Jews inherit the land as Abraham's many children is the false basis of Zionism, since the promises were always conditional on obedience to God's covenant.

15478.title: Don't be a Jonah
15478.summary: The Spirit prepares hearts long before we arrive, so believers should not run from the call like Jonah but preach the gospel and lay up treasure in heaven.

5194.title: Jesus explains His own parables
5194.summary: Jesus' parables show the different hearers of the word, the tares among the faithful, and that those with ears to hear receive more while others lose even what they have.

10781.title: The man to whom the Lord imputeth not sin
10781.summary: Repentance from dead works to faith in God saves by faith alone, and God promises not to impute sin to the believer but to remember it no more.

8303.title: The battle of Armageddon
8303.summary: At Armageddon Christ defeats the beast's armies with the sword of His mouth, casting the antichrist and false prophet into the lake of fire and leaving the wicked to the fowls.

16443.theme: The new heavens and new earth
16443.title: Ezekiel's temple: a promise on condition
16443.summary: The temple vision was a conditional promise to Israel of Christ and a kingdom if they repented, which they refused, as Christ lamented over Jerusalem.

8246.title: Mystery Babylon, the mother of harlots
8246.summary: The great whore on seven hills is Rome and its apostate church, with the false religions sprung from her as harlot daughters, drunk with the blood of the saints she martyred in a trail of blood, until the beast and his kingdom make war with the Lamb and are overcome.

13037.title: No freedom of religion in the Kingdom
13037.summary: Conversion comes by the word and never the sword, so the Baptist distinctive of freedom from state religion is right, churches should be local, independent and Christ led, and a godly people should not allow false religions to be practiced.

16757.title: Standing for the reading of the Word
16757.summary: As all the people stood when Ezra opened the book, Baptists stand out of respect for God's word, and the called out assembly exists to read the scriptures distinctly and give the sense.

254.title: Pharaoh as the example of how reprobation works
254.summary: Pharaoh hardened his own heart through the first five plagues before God hardened it, showing that reprobation, like salvation, is a free-will choice in which God gives men over after they repeatedly refuse to acknowledge Him.

279.title: Normal unsaved sinners are not reprobates
279.summary: Ordinary unsaved sinners still have a conscience and God's law in their hearts and have not been turned over, whereas reprobates are twice-dead children of Satan, neither alive in the flesh nor in the Spirit.

950.title: Romans 11 and the reprobate nation of Israel
950.summary: Paul's argument in Romans 11 is that the remnant are those Jews who believe the Gospel, and that God does not hold out salvation indefinitely but cuts off the unbelieving, whether individuals or a nation, and turns them over to reprobation.

3410.title: Agrippa's mockery and the reprobate mind
3410.summary: Agrippa's mocking response to Paul marks him as reprobate, since the reprobate mind knows the truth of salvation yet rejects it with a hardened heart and seared conscience.

4368.title: Examine yourselves whether ye be reprobate
4368.summary: In 2 Corinthians 13 Paul turns the Corinthians' accusations back on them, asking whether they themselves are reprobate, which shows that Christians may judge the signs of reprobation such as sodomy and false gospels by what people say and do.

5752.title: Reprobation is not about the sin
5752.summary: Whether a person is saved or given over to reprobation depends on his relationship with God rather than the size of his sins, and most people are ordinary unregenerate sinners for whom there is hope until death unless they become reprobate.

6005.title: Unto every good work reprobate
6005.summary: Titus 1:16 describes Catholic, Orthodox and Anglican clergy, works-based false salvationists, LDS and JW leaders and Calvinist lordshippers, who are rejected of God and given over to their own unrighteousness and whose mouths must be stopped by the word of God.

6317.title: The wicked husbandmen given over
6317.summary: In the parable of the vineyard Jesus shows the Jews who knew the truth yet sought to kill Him, so God gave them over to a reprobate mind and will destroy them and give the kingdom to others, contrary to dispensationalism.

6545.title: The way of Cain, the first reprobate
6545.summary: Jude warns against reprobates who teach the damnable heresy of works and turn liberty into lasciviousness, using Cain as the first reprobate and first works-based heretic.

6898.title: The Reprobate Doctrine and the three states of man
6898.summary: The Reprobate Doctrine, taught throughout both Testaments, describes one of man's three spiritual states, the twice-dead who are utterly rejected by God, and Christians must stop lumping them in with common sinners so they can defend their families and communities.

6993.title: The reprobate Sodomites of Genesis 19
6993.summary: The Sodomites who sought to rape the angels were reprobates given over by God to unnatural lusts and all unrighteousness after freely rejecting Him, as Romans 1 and Pharaoh's example show, unlike the common sins of ordinary men.

6995.title: Sodomy as the outward sign of the reprobate mind
6995.summary: Men are rejected by choice rather than blood or sin, and open, proud sodomy is the clearest outward sign of the reprobate mind, so there are no repentant sodomites, though not every reprobate is a sodomite.

8593.title: Thorns and briers rejected and burned
8593.summary: Hebrews 6:8's thorns and briers are the same as the corrupt trees, tares and fruitless trees of Matthew 7 and Jude, namely the reprobates turned over by God whose end is to be burned.

8598.title: Too late, reprobate
8598.summary: Reprobation is real and comes after God has repeatedly led a man to repentance and been rebuffed, so readers must accept the free gift of salvation now because the Spirit will not pursue them forever.

8758.title: Our bad report and hardened hearts
8758.summary: Hebrews warns that saved believers who fall back into dead works can give the lost cause to harden their hearts until it is too late, so Christians bear a grave responsibility to walk righteously so that any rejection is the unbeliever's own fault.

9467.title: The reprobate Jews as whited sepulchres
9467.summary: Jesus' late preaching in Luke 13 and Matthew 23 was aimed at the reprobate Jewish leaders, hypocrites relying on genealogy and works who are the tares and fruitless trees, unable to come to repentance.

9558.title: For this cause God gave them up
9558.summary: Romans 1 explains the cause and effect plainly: because men rejected God, He gave them up and over to a reprobate mind, filled with all unrighteousness, not some.

9992.title: Pharaoh and the Reprobate Doctrine
9992.summary: Pharaoh is an Old Testament picture of the Reprobate Doctrine, refusing God's repeated chances until God gave him over and hardened his heart so he could not believe, and modern Christians who reject this truth accept wolves among the sheep.

10688.title: It is too late for some
10688.summary: Contrary to the claim that God never gives up on anyone, Scripture shows many individuals and nations from Sodom and Pharaoh to Belshazzar and Judah for whom it became too late, and though most have until death to believe, some are given up while still alive.

10707.title: Cause and effect in Romans 1
10707.summary: Romans 1's because and for this cause show that sodomy is the effect of reprobation, not an unpardonable sin, and that reprobation is a process in which God gives chances first, as with Cain and Pharaoh.

10709.title: Tares among the wheat
10709.summary: A professed ex-sodomite who claims salvation by repenting of sin is a red flag, since Jesus, Peter and Jude all teach that reprobates creep into churches as tares among the wheat and can be known by their traits.

10889.title: Modern Jews as reprobate silver
10889.summary: Modern Jews are not the descendants of the twelve tribes but a people defined by rejecting Jesus, given up and cursed by God as reprobate silver, which undoes the dispensationalist hope for their salvation.

11017.title: Mark them which cause divisions
11017.summary: God has marked reprobates in two clear ways, being sodomites or false teachers who usurp the Gospel for gain and lead others astray, and believers are commanded to mark and avoid them rather than dismiss these warnings.

11392.title: The peace offering and the reprobate doctrine
11392.summary: Leviticus 19's ban on eating the peace offering on the third day pictures the reprobate doctrine of Romans 1 and Hebrews 6, that there comes a time when it is too late to receive God's offer.

11835.title: Zedekiah hardened his heart
11835.summary: Like Israel in the wilderness, Zedekiah hardened his heart against God's word and was rejected as reprobate, so believers must not harden their hearts but exhort one another and stay steadfast while the world goes after strong delusion.

12899.title: Idolatry and reprobate nations
12899.summary: Nations that turn to idolatry behave as Romans 1 describes and are given over to God's judgment, as the Canaanites and Israel were, and Catholic and Orthodox idolatry has brought that same judgment on Europe and America.

15256.title: Waters of life shut up from reprobates
15256.summary: Hezekiah stopping the fountains against blaspheming Sennacherib pictures how those who do not retain God in their knowledge have the water of life shut up from them and so come to spoil and harm God's people.

16219.title: Statutes that were not good
16219.summary: In Ezekiel 20 God gave idolatrous Israel and Judah over to strong delusion and statutes that were not good, as Romans 1 describes, while still pleading with their hardened hearts and promising the kingdom to come.

278.title: Reprobates are children of the devil
278.summary: From Titus 1:16 and Acts 13:10 he teaches that reprobates, who profess God but deny Him in works, are the children of the devil working all unrighteousness.

300.title: Reprobate silver: the unbelieving Jews rejected
300.summary: He teaches that Paul frames Jewish persecution as reprobate versus elect, that per Jeremiah 6:30 the unbelieving Jews are rejected of God while saved Greek and Jew are now His elect, and that Jewish antichrists are turned over to a reprobate mind.

3715.title: Abusers of themselves and the reprobate doctrine
3715.summary: He argues that modern translations twist 1 Corinthians 6:9-11 into sodomites being saved, which contradicts Romans 1 and the reprobate doctrine, and that the phrase more likely means other fornication such as prostitution or masturbation.

4025.title: Soul winning creates reprobates
4025.summary: He teaches that preaching the Gospel, as God intends, also creates reprobates, because the truth must be known and rejected for men to be given up as Romans 1:21-25 describes.

5751.title: What reprobation is
5751.summary: He defines reprobation as a free will condition of unbelief in which men who do not wish to retain God in their knowledge are given over by Him, made unable to believe and twice-dead, with unnatural lusts as its effect rather than its cause.

6119.title: Blasphemy of the Holy Ghost and reprobation
6119.summary: From Mark 3 he teaches that blasphemy of the Holy Ghost leads to reprobation, that some like the Pharisees, Cain and Pharaoh are turned over to a reprobate mind and unable to believe, and that unnatural sin is a symptom of reprobation, not its cause.

6502.title: Children of the devil are spiritual seed
6502.summary: He rejects the serpent seed doctrine as damnable and teaches that the children of the devil are reprobates given over by God, a spiritual seed that does not reproduce but recruits.

6726.title: Reprobate silver: a national identity
6726.summary: Quoting Romans 1:18-32 and Jeremiah 6:30, he teaches that the Jews who rejected the Messiah are reprobate by their individual free will and collectively judged, so that it is their national identity.

6899.title: Reprobates and the nature of evil
6899.summary: He says many reject the reprobate doctrine because they do not understand evil, which often looks pitiable rather than malevolent, while reprobate false teachers use mercy to take advantage, as Jesus understood in Matthew 23.

6994.title: Spiritual blindness like the men of Sodom
6994.summary: He teaches that reprobates with seared consciences prey on children as the men of Sodom did, and that as Sodom's men were struck blind God gives reprobates spiritual blindness so they cannot see the truth they rejected.

8591.title: Impossible to renew them unto repentance
8591.summary: From Hebrews 6 he teaches that those who were enlightened, tasted the word and were called by the Holy Ghost yet rejected it are reprobate, and it is impossible for them to be renewed again unto repentance.

8594.title: Churches that no longer teach reprobation
8594.summary: He charges that most churches no longer teach reprobation and wrongly say it is never too late for sodomites and corrupters of the word, though scripture says their end is to be burned.

9592.title: Millstone warning to reprobate pedophiles
9592.summary: From Luke 17 he teaches that reprobate sodomites recruit by offending children and that Jesus tells them they would be better drowned, then applies the warning against offending others to believers too.

10013.title: Pharaoh, Jannes and Jambres
10013.summary: He teaches that Pharaoh hardening his heart and the magicians Jannes and Jambres picture the reprobate concerning the faith, and warns believers to know such men so their children do not harden their hearts.

10687.title: Wherefore God gave them up
10687.summary: He traces the Romans 1 progression in which men who turn God's truth into a lie are given up to uncleanness and vile affections, so that sodomites are punished by their own lusts and no longer convicted.

10690.title: Why the reprobate doctrine matters
10690.summary: He argues that the reprobate doctrine, taught fully in Romans 1, ranks just behind salvation and wrath in importance because it explains the third spiritual state of man, Jews, psychopaths and why tolerating sodomites destroys a society.

10708.title: Filled with all unrighteousness
10708.summary: He teaches that those given over to a reprobate mind are given up to vile affections and over time filled with all the sins of Romans 1:29-31, the traits of psychopaths, and that all sodomites are reprobate though not all reprobates are sodomites.

10711.title: Preaching the reprobate doctrine against wolves
10711.summary: He teaches that reprobates are children of Belial by free will choice, capable of evil a normal mind cannot imagine, and that the reprobate doctrine must be preached so believers do not let them into homes and churches.

10892.title: No plan B for the cut off
10892.summary: From Romans 11 he teaches that those who refuse to believe are cut off and made reprobate, and that doubting this by imagining a secret plan to win them back questions the judgment of God.

11374.title: Homosexuality a curse of reprobation
11374.summary: From Leviticus 18 he teaches that homosexuality is an abomination and an outward sign of being given over to a reprobate mind, the wrath of God revealed.

11633.title: Reprobate silver: Judah rejected
11633.summary: From Jeremiah 6 he teaches that Judah, with its false prophets crying peace, was rejected of God as reprobate silver, and that God judges nations the same way today, especially those called by His name.

13110.title: Make no peace with reprobates
13110.summary: He teaches that the Canaanites were reprobate nations God commanded destroyed, and that believers today should mark and avoid known reprobates, keep them from their congregations and urge magistrates to execute God's law.

13808.title: Denying the reprobate doctrine endangers the flock
13808.summary: From Judges 19 he warns that churches that deny the reprobate doctrine and teach it is never too late let sodomites and predators in among the flock, then cover it up out of pride.

13920.title: Philistines who would not repent
13920.summary: He teaches that the Philistines who felt God's wrath yet asked for His Ark to be taken away picture reprobates who would rather burn in Hell than turn to God, receiving the recompense of Romans 1.

15069.title: Examine yourselves, except ye be reprobates
15069.summary: From 2 Corinthians 13 he teaches that who is of God and who is reprobate is established by the works done, so false teachers are judged by their fruit.

15282.title: Israel a reprobate nation
15282.summary: From Hosea 4 he teaches that Israel, not wishing to retain God in its knowledge, was given over as a reprobate nation to be consumed by its sins, the same judgment coming on the world.

16172.title: God sends strong delusion
16172.summary: From Ezekiel 14 and 2 Thessalonians 2 he teaches that God deceives idolaters who will not repent through lying prophets, sending them strong delusion to believe a lie.

215.title: He is risen: confess and believe
215.summary: Because Christ rose from the dead, whoever believes in his heart and confesses Jesus with his mouth is saved, a free gift that can never be lost.

239.title: Who first trusted in Christ
239.summary: Ephesians 1 does not teach unconditional election, because the chosen are those who first trusted in Christ, and the elect nation is spiritual Israel, not the Jews of the flesh.

251.title: The whole testimony is about free will
251.summary: From Eden to Revelation scripture shows men choosing, and God in His foreknowledge elects to blessings those who have first believed.

252.title: Sovereign does not mean puppet master
252.summary: Lordship salvation and Calvinism grow from modern bibles and a false idea of sovereignty, while God's word says whosoever believeth shall not perish.

276.title: Jude: trees without fruit, twice dead
276.summary: Jude warns saved believers to keep reprobate, ungodly men out of the churches while still winning souls with compassion and with fear.

368.title: Having a form of godliness
368.summary: 2 Timothy 3 lists the marks of the reprobate, false teachers ever learning yet never coming to the truth, and believers should flee them and rely on scripture alone.

767.title: Romans 8: adopted after first believing
767.summary: Paul builds the case for conditional election: we are adopted as sons and joint heirs only after believing, and foreknowledge comes before predestination, which Calvinists reverse.

804.theme: Repentance is a change of mind
804.title: What the Bible means by repent
804.summary: Going through the repentance verses in context shows none requires turning from sin to be saved; repentance for salvation is changing the mind to believe the gospel.

805.theme: Repentance is a change of mind
805.title: No verse says quit sin to be saved
805.summary: There is no clear verse making giving up sin a condition of salvation, so it is not doctrine, since doctrine must come from clear scripture, not men.

806.title: Dead to sin, yet saved as we are
806.summary: Grace is not liberty to sin and the Spirit sanctifies believers over time, but we are saved just as we are while yet sinners, so a wrong idea of repentance should not keep anyone from grace.

827.theme: The church is the Israel of God
827.title: Romans 9: the Jews stumbled at faith
827.summary: Romans 9 is about God using nations and the unbelieving Jews' standing, not Calvinist election, and the Jews missed the promise because they sought righteousness by the law, not faith.

899.title: Christ the end of the law for righteousness
899.summary: Zeal for God without knowledge of the gospel does not save, because Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to everyone that believes and confesses Him.

900.title: Whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord
900.summary: There is no difference between Jew and Greek and no chosen people; every saint from Adam on was saved by believing and calling on the Lord, with nothing added.

903.title: Works without faith are hay and stubble
903.summary: Works of the law, ordinances and holy days cannot save; only faith in Christ saves, even him that worketh not, and many who trusted their works will hear I never knew you.

953.title: Do we live so our loved ones would follow
953.summary: With family and friends rejecting the gospel, believers should ask whether their fearless, grateful, Bible-reading, gospel-preaching lives would draw others to Christ.

1103.theme: Subjection to the powers that be
1103.title: Romans 13: living in godly subjection
1103.summary: Believers are to submit to the authorities God ordains, obeying God rather than man only where they conflict, and trust God, for godly subjection is how God changes who rules over us.

1151.title: Romans 14: the weak brother's conscience
1151.summary: Romans 14 is not about works salvation or licence to sin but about brothers not judging or stumbling those who hold themselves to higher standards in conscience.

1152.title: Compare spiritual with spiritual
1152.summary: Doctrine cannot be built on a verse or two stripped of conditionals and context; scripture must be compared with scripture and let define itself, for God is not the author of confusion.

1154.title: All things are good for meat
1154.summary: Jesus and Paul show dietary laws are vain carnal ordinances, yet the greater good is to love the weaker brother and not give him occasion to stumble.

1188.title: Patience with the weak as God with us
1188.summary: Bearing with weak and burdensome people is hard, but it shows how much more patience God has with all of us.

1189.title: Unto whomsoever much is given
1189.summary: The nearer a believer draws to God the more blessings He gives, and the more is required of him, yet His yoke is light.

1190.title: The cross I take up daily
1190.summary: Giving up the old carnal life comes easily by the Spirit; the real cross is living for God and loving others with the patience He shows us.

1195.title: Remove thy candlestick is not losing salvation
1195.summary: Revelation 1:20 says the candlesticks are the churches, so Christ's warning to remove a candlestick means a church's standing and fellowship, not a saint's salvation.

1238.title: Romans 16: fellow labourers in the churches
1238.summary: Paul's greetings show saved women and men alike labour for the gospel, in local independent churches, plural, while marking those who bring false doctrines.

1272.title: In the beginning was the Word
1272.summary: John opens by establishing that Jesus is the eternal Word, God and with God, the Creator, refuting modalism and claims that Jesus is not God.

1273.title: John 1: as many as received him
1273.summary: John 1 shows Christ lights every man, that the world did not know Him, and that whoever receives Him by believing becomes a son of God, refuting limited atonement and irresistible grace.

1275.title: Cephas, by interpretation, a stone
1275.summary: The Bible translates and defines itself, so Cephas means a stone, not the rock, and the whole Old Testament looked for the Christ.

1322.title: Wine in the Bible and the Lord's supper
1322.summary: Wine in scripture usually means juice, drunkenness is sin, and it was not fermented wine at the Last Supper, so using alcohol as Christ's blood is blasphemous.

1380.title: John 3:13: the Son of man which is in heaven
1380.summary: The KJV's John 3:13 keeps that Christ was in heaven while on earth, while modern versions cut it and so feed dispensationalist error.

1430.title: Ye must be born again
1430.summary: In John 3 Jesus tells Nicodemus a man must be born again of the Spirit, and whosoever believes God gave His Son for the world has everlasting life, with nothing added.

1435.title: Born of water is the first birth
1435.summary: In John 3:5 being born of water means natural birth, as verse 6 explains, not baptism, so baptism is no part of being born again.

1436.theme: Repentance is a change of mind
1436.title: John 3:16 has no and
1436.summary: John 3 says nothing of repenting of sins, Lordship, works, church or baptism to be saved, and so refutes those heresies and TULIP.

1471.title: The I am sayings of Jesus
1471.summary: Jesus' seven I am sayings in John, and before Abraham was, I am, declare His divinity and that eternal life comes only through Him.

1475.title: One soweth and another reapeth
1475.summary: Jesus' meat was winning souls; some sow, some water and some reap, and all rejoice together over the souls won.

1504.title: The Son honoured as the Father
1504.summary: Jesus teaches His authority comes from the Father, that the Godhead are three persons yet one, and that whoever hears and believes hath everlasting life and shall not come into condemnation.

1553.title: I will in no wise cast out
1553.summary: John 6:37-40 refutes both Calvinism, since every one who sees and believes may have life, and loss of salvation, since Christ loses none given Him.

1558.title: The bread of life is not a wafer
1558.summary: Jesus' eating His flesh means believing on His sacrifice, so transubstantiation and real-presence sacraments are carnal misreadings like Nicodemus's.

1559.title: The words I speak are spirit and life
1559.summary: Eating His flesh and drinking His blood is an allegory for believing on Christ, as Jesus Himself explains that the flesh profits nothing.

1560.title: Judas was a devil, never saved
1560.summary: Judas does not show salvation can be lost, because Jesus knew from the beginning he believed not and called him a devil.

1561.title: Lord, to whom shall we go
1561.summary: God is not the author of confusion; scripture explains its own dark sayings, as Peter's confession sums up what Jesus meant.

1572.title: The thousand years Satan is bound
1572.summary: Post-millennialism and amillennialism err because the thousand years is the time Satan is bound after the wrath and Armageddon, which is clearly not now or past.

1626.title: To your tents, O Israel
1626.summary: Israel's rebellion against Rehoboam in 1 Kings 12 pictures the Jews rejecting Christ, and every man going to his own house in John 7 is its parallel.

1668.title: Neither hath this man sinned
1668.summary: Infirmities and hardship are not always the fruit of sin but may be for God's glory, as with Job, so we should not be respecters of persons.

1673.title: What makes a true church
1673.summary: A church is measured by the word preached, sound doctrine, a qualified pastor and soul-winning fruit, not by PayPal or obeying state rules, which Romans 13 says to follow unless they contradict God.

1677.title: If we confess our sins
1677.summary: 1 John is written to the saved: those claiming sinless perfection lie, and believers who confess their sins are forgiven and cleansed in Christ.

1714.title: He hath made him to be sin for us
1714.summary: Christ took all our sin as the propitiation, and by believing we receive His righteousness; that exchange is the testament.

1718.title: None shall pluck them out of my hand
1718.summary: Jesus plainly says His believing sheep have eternal life and shall never perish, held in His and the Father's hand, so once saved is always saved.

1783.title: God will provide himself a lamb
1783.summary: Abraham offering Isaac on Moriah pictures God giving His only begotten Son, from the third day and the wood carried up the hill to the ram in the thorns.

1791.title: I am the resurrection and the life
1791.summary: Jesus wept as one touched with our infirmities, and His word to Martha that whoever believes in Him shall never die is salvation by faith and eternal security.

1833.title: Nations blessed or bred out by God
1833.summary: God judges physical nations, and whether that judgment slows depends not on the unsaved but on saved Christians, chiefly by winning souls.

1909.title: No communion in John's gospel
1909.summary: John, written so the unsaved may be saved, records no breaking of bread or wine at the last supper, so no such ceremony is needed for salvation.

1955.title: The Comforter shall teach you all things
1955.summary: The Holy Ghost, the third person of the Trinity, dwells in believers to teach them, bring scripture to remembrance and give peace without fear.

1957.title: Salvation is not sanctification
1957.summary: Jesus' call in John 14 to keep His commandments was to the already saved, and confusing it with the gospel mixes up salvation with sanctification.

1958.theme: Giving the gospel, not a denomination
1958.title: Converting to a denomination is not soul winning
1958.summary: Winning people to a denomination's traditions and works-based grace is not soul winning; only the gospel of grace through faith in Christ gives a sure hope.

1959.title: Grace is not transactional
1959.summary: Doing works and sacraments to earn or keep salvation is a selfish transaction, not love, since grace is an unearned gift and our only righteousness is Christ's.

2032.title: I am the vine, ye are the branches
2032.summary: The fruit of John 15 is souls won, and a fruitless believer is set aside from usefulness, not cast into hell, for the passage speaks to the saved about service.

2265.title: Christ our Passover on the preparation day
2265.summary: Jesus died on Passover preparation day, Wednesday, as the lamb without blemish, and the three Sabbaths that followed picture His doing all the work, the same faith in the blood that saved since Adam.

2266.title: Two birds, cedar, scarlet and hyssop
2266.summary: The cleansing sacrifice of Leviticus 14 and Isaac on Moriah picture Christ, so everything in the law pointed to Him and the Jews are without excuse.

2299.title: The sign of the prophet Jonas
2299.summary: The tomb was empty before dawn Sunday after three full days and nights, fulfilling the sign of Jonas, and getting this timing wrong opens the door to worse error about Christ's suffering.

2329.title: Lovest thou me? Feed my sheep
2329.summary: Like Peter going back to fishing, saved believers drift into the world, but Christ restores them to feed His sheep and win souls, and each should follow Him without comparing himself to others.

2367.title: Pentecost: the firstfruits of the harvest
2367.summary: The feast of weeks was the firstfruits of the wheat harvest, fulfilled when three thousand were saved at Pentecost.

2376.title: Building on the rock of God's word
2376.summary: Biblical fundamentalism, preaching the whole unchanging word, is the only safeguard, which is why it has been attacked from every direction for two centuries.

2382.title: Rome is shifting sand
2382.summary: The Catholic church adds to God's word and changes doctrine with the times, so it is shifting sand that cannot be a foundation for faith.

2394.title: Pentecost tongues were real languages
2394.summary: The Holy Ghost first indwelt believers when Christ breathed on them in John 20, and at Pentecost He filled them to preach the gospel in real foreign languages, not charismatic gibberish.

2395.theme: Repentance is a change of mind
2395.title: Repent and be baptized: the order of things
2395.summary: In Acts 2:38 Peter calls the Jews to repent of their unbelief in the Christ they crucified, then be baptized, so it teaches neither repenting of sins nor baptism for remission.

2510.title: None other name under heaven
2510.summary: Salvation is only in the name of Jesus Christ, so there is no ecumenical path, no saving by other faiths or works, and no Yeshua of the Hebrew roots movement.

2525.title: Saved Christians believe the word
2525.summary: The sure sign someone is saved is not lifestyle or commandment-keeping but that he believes God's word when it is preached, for God justifies by belief alone.

2535.title: Ananias and Sapphira: chastened unto death
2535.summary: Ananias and Sapphira were saved church members, and their deaths show not lost salvation but that God scourges His own children for sin, even unto death.

2572.title: Acts 6: the office of deacon
2572.summary: Acts 6 and 1 Timothy 3 establish deacons, qualified men who serve the church under the pastor, one of only two offices in the Bible, freeing pastors for prayer and the word.

2619.theme: The church is the Israel of God
2619.title: Stiffnecked and resisting the Holy Ghost
2619.summary: Stephen's history shows Israel's constant rejection of God, so a chosen race outside Christ is fiction; God's theology never changed, only who receives His grace.

2655.theme: Repentance is a change of mind
2655.title: Simon the sorcerer repents as a believer
2655.summary: Peter's rebuke to Simon to repent of his wickedness was to an already saved man who sinned, not a condition of salvation, and the laying on of hands gave gifts, not the indwelling Spirit.

2656.title: How can I, except some man guide me
2656.summary: God sent Philip to the Ethiopian eunuch to show that He will move heaven and earth to bring the gospel to any sincere seeker, answering the question of the man who never heard.

2657.title: If thou believest with all thine heart
2657.summary: Acts 8:37 gives the order of salvation, believing that Jesus is the Son of God and then baptism, which is why modern versions remove or doubt it.

2666.title: Saul was consenting unto his death
2666.summary: By holding the coats Saul consented to Stephen's death, and even passive consent to sin is sin, so believers must boldly stand against evil.

2707.theme: Repentance is a change of mind
2707.title: We all sin every day
2707.summary: Since we all sin daily, repenting from sin for righteousness is foolish; God forgives us in Jesus' name, and the Spirit and word help us overcome sin for our edification.

2709.title: Ananias sent to Saul
2709.summary: Jesus appeared to Saul but sent a man, Ananias, to give him the gospel, showing that people are saved by hearing the word from saved Christians, a duty too many shirk.

2716.title: Make us a king like all the nations
2716.summary: Like Israel demanding a king, Americans seek political overthrow, but every system is judged by God when it turns from Him, so the answer is getting people right with God.

2762.title: Peter sent to Cornelius
2762.summary: As with the eunuch and Saul, God sent a man to preach to Cornelius, and God being no respecter of persons in the gospel does not undo His hierarchies or the nations and borders He sets.

2763.title: Whosoever believeth shall receive remission
2763.summary: Peter's gospel to Cornelius offers remission of sins to whosoever believes, with no turning from sin, works or sacrament.

2764.title: Not my words but the word of God
2764.summary: Those holding another gospel are refuted not by his words but by the whole word of God, read without pride so that it tells us its doctrine.

2839.theme: Repentance is a change of mind
2839.title: Repentance unto life is turning to the Lord
2839.summary: Acts 11 uses granted repentance unto life and turned unto the Lord for the same thing, so biblical repentance is turning to the Lord, with no implied from sin.

2840.title: The collection was for the saints at Jerusalem
2840.summary: Romans 15:27 does not oblige Gentile Christians to fund Jews in Israel; it describes one relief gift to saved Christians at Jerusalem.

2890.theme: Every word of God is pure
2890.title: Easter in Acts 12:4 is not pagan
2890.summary: The KJV's Easter in Acts 12:4 is a deliberate English name for the resurrection feast meaning dawn, not a pagan holiday or a word from Ishtar.

3027.title: The Jerusalem council and the Judaizers
3027.summary: Acts 15 rejects the Judaizers' circumcision and law-keeping for salvation, while the letter's precepts on idols, fornication and blood were for sanctification, not salvation.

3028.title: Peter and Paul preached one gospel
3028.summary: Peter's words at Jerusalem show his gospel is the same as Paul's and Christ's: saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus by faith, not the law.

3070.title: Why Paul circumcised Timothy
3070.summary: Paul refused circumcision for Titus because it was pressed as a condition of salvation, yet circumcised Timothy for access to the Jews, since circumcision is nothing when not made a means of justification.

3071.title: What must I do to be saved
3071.summary: To the Philippian jailer's question Paul answers only believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, with no repenting of sins, surrender, church or sacrament: faith alone, plus nothing.

3072.theme: Repentance is a change of mind
3072.title: Repent of trusting anything but Christ
3072.summary: Romans, John and Acts consistently show salvation by faith alone for all who believe, so what must be repented of is trusting anything besides the finished work of Christ.

3095.title: Circumcision and the yoke of the law
3095.summary: Galatians shows the problem is not the act of circumcision but seeking justification through it, which puts men under the law's yoke and makes the gospel of none effect.

3162.title: I have planted, Apollos watered
3162.summary: Believers should not form cults of personality around the ministers who led them to Christ, since one sows, another waters, and God gives the increase.

3341.title: Not sedition but faith in God
3341.summary: As unbelieving Jerusalem neared judgment, believers needed not take up arms but trust God to judge in His time, for persecution makes His people flourish and fear dims our light.

3342.title: An example of the believers
3342.summary: When loved ones are perishing, believers should stay steadfast and peaceful as an example, since no one will believe our hope if we are as fearful as everyone else.

3409.theme: Repentance is a change of mind
3409.title: Repent and turn to God
3409.summary: Paul's repent and turn to God, and do works meet for repentance, means turning one's trust from false beliefs and works to God, then doing works fitting for that turning.

3412.title: Turning toward the Lord is all we have
3412.summary: Only Bible-believing Christians turning from their own wicked ways to God can delay the wrath America deserves; voting, shooting or vengeance are vanity.

3474.title: I believe God, that it shall be as told me
3474.summary: Paul's shipwreck pictures the Christian life in stormy times, kept by God toward His purpose and called to be a steadfast anchor and example to others.

3503.title: The Bible way to heaven: faith alone
3503.summary: Through John and Acts the one message is that sinners are saved by believing on Christ crucified and risen, not by works or a denomination, and that this free gift sealed by the Spirit can never be lost.

3550.title: Doers of the word, and not hearers only
3550.summary: James calls saved believers to ask God for wisdom in faith and to grow complete by doing the word, visiting the fatherless and widows and not being respecters of persons, noting that saved in James often means delivered from trials, not justified.

3554.title: James 2 is no snare for works salvation
3554.summary: Read in context and compared with the rest of scripture, James 2 is written to the already saved and its rhetorical questions cannot overturn the clear doctrine that we are made righteous by faith alone.

3555.title: Dead faith is faith that profits no one
