3555.summary: Dead faith in James is not absent faith but faith with no outward life to help the needy, since salvation is a free gift while rewards and deliverance from trials come from being doers of the word.

3557.title: Abraham justified by faith before God, by works before men
3557.summary: Comparing James 2 with Romans 4, Abraham was justified before God by faith alone decades before Isaac's offering, which only showed his faith before men, so the man may say passage is a rhetorical device and not doctrine.

3628.title: The preaching of the cross is foolishness to them that perish
3628.summary: Paul rebukes divisions over who baptized whom and teaches that the gospel looks foolish to those seeking signs or human reasoning, while God makes our weakness and meekness His strength.

3638.title: The natural man receiveth not the things of God
3638.summary: The mystery Paul speaks of is Christ plainly revealed, not gnostic secret knowledge, and the things of God are only understood by those quickened by the Spirit while unbelievers stumble in a real spiritual blindness.

3661.title: Gold and silver, or wood, hay and stubble
3661.summary: On the one foundation of Christ our works will be tried by fire, and only what glorifies God such as soul winning and charity is rewarded while worldly disputes, denominations and traditions burn as stubble.

3699.title: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump
3699.summary: Following Matthew 18, Paul commands that an unrepentant fornicator be put out of the church and delivered to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, and churches that tolerate such sin let it spread through the whole body.

3716.title: Washed and sanctified, not saved by quitting sin
3716.summary: 1 Corinthians 6 is no proof of repent-of-your-sins salvation, because Paul says we are washed and justified in Christ, and our liberty means sin is not expedient and harms us, not that we lose the kingdom.

3717.title: Churches soft on fornication
3717.summary: Fornication, including cohabiting couples who call it love, is sin and self-harm that churches wink at, though the apostles in Acts made a point of warning against it.

3753.title: Due benevolence: better to marry than to burn
3753.summary: Celibacy is good for those gifted with it, but God gave marriage against fornication, and husband and wife must not defraud each other of marital relations except briefly by consent for fasting.

3771.title: Meat offered to idols and the weaker conscience
3771.summary: Knowing idols are nothing, the believer is at liberty to eat, yet should forgo that liberty if it causes a weaker brother or an unbeliever to stumble, seeking to build others up rather than please himself.

3798.title: They which preach the gospel should live of the gospel
3798.summary: Ministers of the word have the right to be supported by the church as Paul shows, and like Paul we serve willingly out of love for incorruptible crowns, unlike those who labour to earn salvation and remain debtors.

3825.theme: Temptation and the way of escape
3825.title: The examples of Israel and the way of escape
3825.summary: Israel was delivered yet fell into idolatry and fornication and was chastened, as an example to us, and the way of escape God provides from every temptation is found by staying in His word.

3826.title: Liberty, but not at the expense of others
3826.summary: Our liberty in Christ is not a license to sin, so we forgo things that would hinder others from the faith, which is loving our neighbour and not weakness, though it never means accepting wickedness.

3828.title: No real presence, only remembrance
3828.summary: There is no sacrament in the Lord's supper; believers remember Christ and give thanks whenever they eat together, and transubstantiation and real presence are neither taught nor hinted at.

3851.title: Hair, coverings and God's order
3851.summary: 1 Corinthians 11 teaches long hair for women and short hair for men, head coverings are not worth arguing over, and the main doctrine is the order of headship under God.

3852.title: The spirit of the Lord's supper, not the flesh
3852.summary: How often a church observes the Lord's supper matters less than the spirit of it, and treating the physical bread and wine as a source of grace, as Rome and her offshoots do, is eating damnation.

3853.title: Rites and ordinances become a religion unto themselves
3853.summary: Like the Pharisees, churches that put their weight on rites, washings and sacraments lose the spiritual meaning and slide into tying salvation to ritual, when sin and salvation are matters of the heart.

3877.title: Tongues were real languages, not babbling
3877.summary: The gift of tongues was the Spirit-given ability to speak and understand other languages to spread the gospel, not the unintelligible babbling and floor-flopping of Pentecostals.

3905.title: Charity, the more excellent way
3905.summary: Above every spiritual gift stands charity, the selfless unfeigned love that reflects God's love in Christ, and works done for selfish ends, above all to earn salvation, are uncharitable.

3906.title: Charity is the motive, not the gift
3906.summary: Read with chapter 12, charity means caring for each member of the church and not coveting others' gifts, since tongues or knowledge without love profits nothing.

3908.title: Faith, hope and charity abide
3908.summary: Tongues, prophecy and knowledge fade away, but faith, hope and charity endure into the kingdom of God.

3925.title: Tongues, prophecy and the preserved English word
3925.summary: Tongues were languages and prophecy is preaching scripture to understanding, so services in a dead language, back-to-the-Greek scholars and Ruckmanites all err, and God has preserved His word in English in the KJV needing no outside interpreter.

3926.title: Let your women keep silence in the churches
3926.summary: Women are to learn in silence in church under the pastor and ask their husbands at home, though they teach their children and share the gospel, and every member serves the same goal without pride in role.

3998.title: The God of all comfort in tribulation
3998.summary: God comforts us in our troubles so we can comfort others, and sealed with the earnest of the Spirit we can count even tribulation as giving glory to God.

4023.title: Forgive and comfort the repentant
4023.summary: As Paul told the church to forgive and restore the disciplined brother, parents should discipline in love and then truly forgive and forget, or they teach their children a works-based relationship with God.

4048.title: The letter killeth, but the Spirit giveth life
4048.summary: The letter of the law condemned us and served as a schoolmaster, while the Spirit gives liberty, and the veil of Moses pictures the veil on Jewish hearts that is taken away when they believe on Christ.

4089.title: Lamps in earthen pitchers: Gideon's 300
4089.summary: Gideon's men breaking pitchers to reveal lamps pictures Paul's treasure in earthen vessels, where God works through weak believers so that He alone gets the glory.

4115.title: Ambassadors of reconciliation
4115.summary: Our letters of commendation are the souls we win, our glorified body is sure but clothed by our works, and as new men reconciled to God we are ambassadors bringing others the same reconciliation.

4116.title: Saved by faith, shown by works
4116.summary: 2 Corinthians 5 is a longer form of James 2: we are saved by faith alone, but unbelievers who judge by appearance see our faith through our works, which wins them to Christ.

4117.title: Forsake all and gain an hundredfold
4117.summary: The more we are willing to lose family, comfort and nation for Christ, the more God blesses, so we should let go and trust Him rather than fear or politics.

4147.title: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers
4147.summary: Being unequally yoked reaches beyond marriage to every alliance with unbelievers and Christ-haters, and believers must come out and be separate rather than seek salvation from worldly allies.

4160.title: Romans 13: obey until the law is explicitly anti-Christ
4160.summary: Those who reject the plain reading of Romans 13 often harbour wrath, and believers should pay tribute and live without offence until the law openly demands they deny God, then obey God and accept persecution.

4164.title: If my people shall humble themselves
4164.summary: A nation is saved by its believers turning to God, as promised in 2 Chronicles 7:14, not by online poses and ideological debates.

4204.title: Liberality to brethren in need
4204.summary: Those who have are to share with brethren who lack, and such generosity is rewarded with spiritual abundance, reflecting the charity God shows us.

4207.title: Pure religion: the fatherless and widows
4207.summary: A godly nation cares for the poor, widows and fatherless through individual Christians and their local churches, and both libertarian bootstraps contempt and leftist state dependency are unbiblical.

4395.title: Another gospel, let him be accursed
4395.summary: Any religion that mixes works, adds to faith or credits anything but the blood of Jesus preaches another gospel and is accursed, for we are saved by grace alone through faith alone in Christ alone.

4420.title: One gospel preached by Paul and the apostles
4420.summary: Galatians and Acts 15 show Paul preached the same faith-alone gospel the apostles agreed on, against the Judaizers then and Hebrew roots and works teachers now.

4421.title: Not justified by the works of the law
4421.summary: Galatians 2:16 plainly says no flesh is justified by the works of the law, so anyone depending on turning from sin or keeping ordinances frustrates grace and will perish.

4436.title: O foolish Galatians
4436.summary: Those who add law, repentance from sin, rites or traditions to the gospel are foolish Galatians, and most of Christendom does so and is given over to blindness so they cannot see faith alone in plain scripture.

4437.theme: The church is the Israel of God
4437.title: Abraham's seed is Christ, and believers are heirs
4437.summary: Believing Gentiles are Abraham's children through Christ the one seed, the law was a schoolmaster and not a separate dispensation, and no Jew, Rome or church can annul or add to God's covenant of faith.

4438.title: Spiritual blindness is real
4438.summary: Those who cannot see clear scripture are under a literal God-given blindness, which he learned is real only after giving the gospel and commenting on scripture publicly.

4471.title: Sons of the freewoman, not the bondwoman
4471.summary: Believers are adopted heirs freed from the tutors of the law, and as Isaac and Ishmael show, those born of the Spirit inherit while those under the bondage of works are cast out.

4472.title: The freeborn sons and the bondage of works
4472.summary: Believers trusting Christ alone are freeborn joint heirs, and any church adding sacraments or works to grace is accursed and holds people in bondage.

4474.title: The Good Samaritan and the lawyer
4474.summary: Jesus answered the lawyer that keeping the two great commandments would bring life, then showed through the Good Samaritan that no one actually keeps the law, so none are righteous by works.

4511.title: Stand fast in liberty: Christ shall profit you nothing
4511.summary: Trusting circumcision or any added work, even partly, makes one a debtor to the whole law so that Christ profits them nothing.

4512.title: The whole law is love
4512.summary: The whole law is loving our neighbour, even our enemy, as Christ did, which none of us can do perfectly, but staying in the word and prayer brings forth the fruit of the Spirit in our walk.

4513.title: The works of the flesh indict the law-keeper
4513.summary: Those keeping circumcision to be saved are still indicted by the works of the flesh, which no ceremony can erase, and only faith gives the inheritance.

4514.title: Traditions not even in the Bible
4514.summary: The Galatians at least followed something God once ordained, but the mystery religion of Babylon and her harlot daughters trusts in extra-biblical traditions of men.

4580.title: Predestinated in Christ, not chosen individuals
4580.summary: In Ephesians 1 it is Christ who was predestinated and we are chosen and accepted only in Him, obtaining the inheritance after we hear and trust the gospel and are sealed, so Calvinism misplaces the focus.

4581.title: Sealed unto the day of redemption
4581.summary: Once we believe we are purchased by the blood and sealed by the Holy Spirit as an earnest until God redeems us at the resurrection.

4585.title: All believers are saints
4585.summary: Saint is the New Testament title for every believer, not a rank Rome bestows for works, and the peace announced at Christ's birth is peace between God and men through grace.

4604.title: By grace are ye saved through faith
4604.summary: Jew and Gentile alike were children of wrath and are saved only by grace through faith, not works, made one new man in Christ with the partition removed.

4622.theme: The church is the Israel of God
4622.title: The mystery: Gentiles are fellowheirs
4622.summary: The mystery revealed to Paul is that Gentiles are fellowheirs in Christ, under the same dispensation of grace given to all men since Adam, not a separate one.

4623.title: No chosen people but in Christ
4623.summary: Paul refutes the idea that Jews are God's chosen and Gentile believers lesser, there is only the one dispensation of grace, and Rome's sin of presumption keeps people from assurance.

4662.title: Put off the old man, put on the new
4662.summary: Grown in the unity of the faith, believers walk not as the reprobate who are past feeling but as new men convicted by the Spirit, putting away lying, wrath and corrupt communication.

4663.title: Sealed unto the day of redemption, against false churches
4663.summary: Believers are sealed by the Spirit with eternal life, and churches teaching you can lose or must earn salvation, or that they are the body, are false churches that cannot save.

4664.title: What corrupt communication means
4664.summary: Corrupt communication in Ephesians 4 means speech in wrath, envy, backbiting and false accusation, not merely vulgar words, and legalists who fuss over a stray word while backbiting have it backwards.

4690.title: Walk as children of light
4690.summary: Heirs of God should not walk as the children of disobedience but be filled with the Spirit through psalms, hymns and thanksgiving, rather than filling their minds with worldly entertainment.

4691.title: Wives submit, husbands love
4691.summary: Wives submitting and husbands loving their wives as Christ the church is a unifying order, and men abandoning their role and the gender-war movements on both sides tear the home apart.

4692.title: Revival starts with the children of light
4692.summary: A nation slouching toward Gomorrah fails because Christians compromise, so revival begins with believers walking in the Spirit, honest and submitted to God.

4719.title: Obey masters and powers as unto God
4719.summary: Children, servants, wives and subjects should honour authority even when it is harsh, unless commanded to sin, working diligently and blamelessly because they serve God.

4722.title: The whole armour of God
4722.summary: Honouring parents and working faithfully is possible because we are equipped with the whole armour of God, so walking in truth, righteousness, the gospel, faith, salvation and the word we need not fear the wicked.

4767.title: Work out your own salvation is not doubt
4767.summary: Work out your own salvation does not deny assurance, since Paul in the same epistle is confident God will perform the work He began in them by the gospel.

4768.title: Absent from the body, present with the Lord
4768.summary: Believers who die before the resurrection go consciously to Heaven rather than soul sleep, as the damned are in torment now and the souls under the altar cry how long, for created beings remain within time.

4790.title: Counting my own righteousness as dung
4790.summary: Paul counted his lineage, circumcision and law-keeping as dung to have the righteousness of God by faith, warning of the concision, while still pressing on in sanctification out of love.

4810.title: Be careful for nothing
4810.summary: The believer's normal state should be rejoicing and prayer with thanksgiving instead of worry, content in any state and trusting God to supply all need.

4811.title: Letting go of fear for this world
4811.summary: Fear and worldly cares brought him misery, and accepting by faith that they do not matter, with thanks whatever the outcome, is where God blesses most.

4826.title: The Lord also hath put away thy sin
4826.summary: Nathan's word to David shows a saved man whose sin is not imputed, yet God still chastens His sons on earth, sometimes harshly.

4876.title: John the Baptist and believer's baptism
4876.summary: John baptized believers by immersion as the answer of a good conscience, not to wash away sin, and his hard preaching told the Pharisees that descent from Abraham would not save them.

4882.title: Christ the image of the invisible God
4882.summary: Jesus is the express image of the Father, creator of all and firstborn from the dead, who reconciles believers to God, and being translated into His kingdom is a change of spirit, not of body.

4899.theme: Every word of God is pure
4899.title: Man shall not live by bread alone
4899.summary: Satan tempts us as he did Eve and Christ by twisting scripture to justify the flesh, and Jesus shows we overcome him and live by every word of God.

4901.title: Fruit of souls won, and false prophets who bear none
4901.summary: Throughout the New Testament the work of believers is winning souls for God's increase, while false prophets with doctrines of works and philosophy cannot bring forth that fruit.

4902.title: Judaizers: Satan's main play
4902.summary: The repeated New Testament warnings against Judaizers, law-keeping, dietary rules and holy days show this is Satan's main attack on the churches.

4915.title: Set your affection on things above
4915.summary: Saved believers mortify the lusts of the flesh, put on the new man, and show it in honest dealing, godly homes and diligent work done for the Lord.

4959.title: Righteousness exceeding the scribes and Pharisees
4959.summary: Christ came to fulfil the law not destroy it, and only His righteousness, not the loophole righteousness of the Pharisees, can bring us into the kingdom.

4965.title: An excellent spirit like Daniel
4965.summary: The Sermon on the Mount calls us to excellence beyond the minimum, and like Daniel we should be so blameless that enemies can only accuse our faith, trusting God to deliver us.

4978.title: Alms, prayer and fasting in secret, and take no thought
4978.summary: Jesus condemns public religious show, vain repetitions and treasure on earth, which he likens to the Catholic church, and teaches us to seek God's kingdom first and not worry, since worry is worship of the god of this world.

5030.theme: False prophets known by their fruit
5030.title: Judge righteously and know false prophets by their fruit
5030.summary: Christians are to judge righteously after removing their own beam, and the fruit by which false prophets are known is their followers and lack of soul winning, not self-righteous fruit inspection.

5032.title: I never knew you
5032.summary: Depart from me, I never knew you proves no saved person loses salvation, and the will of the Father is that whoever sees the Son and believes on Him has everlasting life.

5144.title: He that endureth to the end shall be saved from what
5144.summary: The Spirit gives believers words under persecution, and saved in this passage means delivered from tribulation, so using it for preservation of the saints that can be lost is a false doctrine.

5145.title: Not peace, but a sword
5145.summary: The gospel brings division even in our families, and loving Christ above parents and children means taking up the cross and bearing their hatred for His name.

5181.theme: Rest in Christ, not the sabbath
5181.title: The sabbath fulfilled in Christ
5181.summary: The sabbath pictured our rest in Christ without works, so no day is esteemed above another and our works now serve to seek the lost.

5182.title: Blasphemy against the Holy Ghost
5182.summary: The Pharisees who attributed the Spirit's work to Beelzebub were reprobate beyond forgiveness, and every idle word of the wicked will be judged.

5185.title: Cleaning the house without God
5185.summary: Turning over a new leaf and quitting sins without Christ leaves a man worse off and still judged, for real cleansing only comes through faith in Him.

5195.title: Hell is real, and Mary had other children
5195.summary: Jesus preached Hell often, and Matthew 13 names Jesus' brothers and sisters, refuting Mary's perpetual virginity.

5225.title: Corban and what truly defiles a man
5225.summary: Jesus exposed the Pharisees' Corban loophole as breaking God's law to honour parents and taught that defilement comes from the heart, not unwashed hands, food or ordinances.

5226.title: Honour thy father and mother means providing for them
5226.summary: Honour in scripture includes financial support, so adult children must take in and provide for their aged parents rather than claim Corban or leave them to a church or the state.

5265.title: The leaven of the Pharisees is their doctrine
5265.summary: Jesus uses bread for the word and leaven for false doctrine, and natural men who take it literally turn it into a materialistic cannibal sacrament.

5266.theme: Christ the foundation of the church
5266.title: Upon this rock: the confession of Christ
5266.summary: The rock Christ builds His church on is the truth Peter confessed, that Jesus is the Christ the Son of God, not Peter himself, and believers are lively stones built on it.

5268.title: Get thee behind me, Satan: the first pope rebuked
5268.summary: Peter's rebuke right after his confession shows he held no special position, and a materialistic, literal religion of relics, wine and vestments savours the things of men and is satanic.

5269.title: Whosoever will lose his life for my sake
5269.summary: Believers should take up the cross willing to die for Christ, because our blessed hope is eternal life and reward at His coming in glory.

5270.title: Faith in things unseen against material religion
5270.summary: Faith is the evidence of things unseen, and the world's religions need idols, crackers, priesthoods and temples because they are materialistic and cannot save.

5280.theme: A more sure word of prophecy
5280.title: The transfiguration and a more sure word
5280.summary: Peter who witnessed the transfiguration says the written word of prophecy is even more sure, and the glory on the mount pales beside the cross and resurrection.

5281.title: Then are the children free
5281.summary: As kings take tribute from strangers not their children, believers are free sons who pay nothing to enter the kingdom, yet as sojourners still pay tribute to whom it is due.

5305.title: Repenting from dead works, not of sin
5305.summary: The unrepentant are those who trust their own turning from sin instead of repenting from dead works toward the free gift of faith in Christ's finished work.

5309.title: The concrete gospel by which we are saved
5309.summary: The gospel is a specific thing to believe (God, our sin, death as its wage, Christ's death and resurrection), and adding a required repentance of sin puts a man back under the whole law.

5323.theme: After the tribulation, before the wrath
5323.title: The falling away first, and the corrupt versions
5323.summary: 2 Thessalonians 2 says the falling away and the man of sin come before the day of Christ, and modern versions that turn the falling away into rebellion and lawlessness set believers up to be seen as the rebels against the antichrist.

5335.title: Seventy times seven: forgive as forgiven
5335.summary: One who has truly received God's grace for a great debt will forgive others, and a held grudge against one sincerely asking forgiveness shows a heart that never understood grace.

5337.title: If God forgives blasphemy, forgive petty offence
5337.summary: Since God forgives all manner of sin and blasphemy against Himself, those under grace have no ground to withhold forgiveness over the petty squabbles of this life.

5339.title: The unforgiving servant was never saved
5339.summary: The unforgiving servant did not lose salvation but never truly received the king's free forgiveness, because in pride he never admitted he owed the debt.

5373.title: Christ the propitiation for the whole world
5373.summary: A chain of scriptures shows Christ was the propitiation for the sins of the whole world, and by believing we are clothed in His righteousness.

5375.title: What God hath joined: divorce is adultery
5375.summary: Jesus answered the Pharisees from scripture that Moses allowed divorce only for the hardness of men's hearts, that what God joins no man may put asunder, and that the Pharisees sought loopholes rather than strictness.

5378.title: The rich young man's self-righteousness
5378.summary: The rich young man claimed righteousness by the law but would not forsake his riches to follow Christ, showing that pride and self-righteousness keep men from the salvation the poor in spirit receive by faith.

5380.title: Tribulation for His name brings reward
5380.summary: Those who forsake all and suffer tribulation for Christ's name will rule with Him, so believers should not seek to avoid the tribulation that brings reward in heaven.

5395.title: The first shall be last: humility in service
5395.summary: The parable of the labourers rebukes pride and striving over who is greatest; entrance to the Kingdom is the reward, and service done in childlike humility is greater than works done in contention.

5397.title: Whosoever will be chief, let him be servant
5397.summary: In Christ's kingdom greatness is servanthood, so believers are to be meek ministers to others, accepting division and tribulation for His name.

5409.title: Christ the bridegroom and the whore of Babylon
5409.summary: Scripture pictures God's people as a bride and idolatry as adultery and whoredom, which is why the Roman Catholic Church is shown as the whore of Babylon, mother of harlots.

5414.title: Ask in prayer, believing, and receive
5414.summary: From the withered fig tree Jesus taught that whatsoever we ask in prayer believing we shall receive, a literal promise to grow in by faith.

5415.title: Repented not, that ye might believe him
5415.summary: The parable of the two sons shows Biblical repentance is turning to believe God's word, which the publicans and harlots did and the self-righteous chief priests did not.

5430.title: The wedding feast and the wedding garment
5430.summary: The wedding feast parable shows God inviting all after the Jews rejected Him, and the guest without a wedding garment, in his own righteousness, is cast out because only Christ's imputed righteousness clothes us.

5431.title: Go to the highways and bid all to the feast
5431.summary: As God's servants our role is to go out to the highways and compel all, bad and good, to come to the wedding feast of the Son.

5432.title: Render unto God the things that are God's
5432.summary: Jesus turned the tribute question to show the Pharisees did not give God His due, and the worldly fixate on the Caesar half while the spiritual see the call to render unto God.

5433.title: Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures
5433.summary: Jesus' constant rebuke was that men knew not the scriptures, and casting doubt on God's complete, preserved word is Satan's work from Eden onward.

5439.title: Verses misused for repenting of sin
5439.summary: Ezekiel 14, Luke 13 and Revelation 9, rightly divided, are about national judgment, misunderstanding, and unbelief, not repenting of sins to be born again.

5444.title: I changed my mind about how to be saved
5444.summary: No one needs to change his mind that sin is wrong, since conscience already tells him; real repentance is changing one's mind about what must be done to be saved and believing on Christ's blood.

5456.title: Godly sorrow and the Corinthians' repentance
5456.summary: 2 Corinthians 7 shows already-saved believers repenting of sin after Paul's rebuke, and teaches that godly sorrow can lead to repentance unto salvation while worldly sorrow works death.

5457.title: Sorrow is not itself repentance
5457.summary: Godly sorrow for sin is not repentance but one thing that can work it, and others come to repentance through compassion and the witness of believers, in tears or in joy.

5458.title: The fruits of godly sorrow
5458.summary: Paul's list of carefulness, clearing, indignation, fear, desire, zeal and revenge shows the fruits of godly sorrow, useful both for getting right with God and for judging whether another's sorrow is genuine.

5459.title: Conflating godly sorrow with saving repentance
5459.summary: Making repentance of sin the way to be born again confuses sorrow with the change of mind toward faith in Christ, turns salvation into works, and shuts out many who come to Christ by other paths.

5460.title: Resentment toward those saved without hitting bottom
5460.summary: Teaching that one must repent of sins to be saved can make those who came to Christ through deep sorrow resent and doubt believers who came by easier paths.

5461.title: Repentance of sin breeds hypocrisy and testimonial pride
5461.summary: Emphasising what one turned from instead of what one turned to creates a caste of the more saved, fruit inspectors and boastful testimonials, when all were equally damned and saved by grace alone.

5529.theme: After the tribulation, before the wrath
5529.title: He that endureth: saved out of tribulation
5529.summary: Jesus' promise that those who endure will be saved is, in context, physical deliverance of the saints from the tribulation at His coming, not a condition of spiritual salvation.

5530.title: The last days and the Olivet question
5530.summary: We have been in the last days since the Ascension, and the temple's destruction is a separate prophecy from Christ's coming, which dispensationalists and preterists both mix up.

5532.theme: After the tribulation, before the wrath
5532.title: Immediately after the tribulation of those days
5532.summary: Matthew 24 puts the great tribulation first and Christ's visible coming and the gathering of the saints immediately after it, with the darkened sun and moon of Revelation 6, refuting the pre-trib rapture.

5548.theme: After the tribulation, before the wrath
5548.title: Revealed from heaven in flaming fire
5548.summary: 2 Thessalonians 1 lines up with Matthew 24 and Revelation 6: out of tribulation Christ is revealed from heaven, gathers the living and resurrected saints, and takes vengeance on the disobedient.

5549.title: Vengeance is His: the day of His wrath
5549.summary: The disobedient will meet Christ's coming in fear and everlasting destruction, and believers suffering tribulation can take heart that vengeance belongs to God and He is faithful.

5551.theme: After the tribulation, before the wrath
5551.title: Let no man deceive you: these come first
5551.summary: Scripture says the falling away and the revealing of the man of sin come before the day of the Lord, so believers are to watch the signs as the fig tree instead of trusting the pre-trib imminence teaching.

5554.title: This generation shall not pass
5554.summary: This generation means the generation that sees the signs, not merely the first century or the Jews, and Christ's word that their house is left desolate shows God's wrath on the unbelieving Jews.

5555.theme: After the tribulation, before the wrath
5555.title: The false hope of escaping tribulation
5555.summary: All who live godly will suffer, and the Left Behind hope of a secret rapture before the worst is a snare belonging to lukewarm churches and drunken watchmen.

5568.title: The ten virgins and the oil of the Spirit
5568.summary: The oil is the Holy Spirit and the foolish virgins are professing Christians who never received Him, and none can borrow another's oil once the bridegroom comes.

5569.title: The talents: same joy, different rule
5569.summary: The faithful servants both enter the joy of the Lord though given different rule, while the unprofitable servant represents the unsaved who thought wickedly of God and refused His gift.

5571.title: Salvation cannot be lost, only refused
5571.summary: The foolish virgins and unprofitable servant were never saved; they refused what was offered, for salvation cannot be lost, only refused.

5572.title: The sheep and the goats: charity shows faith
5572.summary: The charity of the sheep is how their faith is shown and lived, not the means of entering the Kingdom, and the goats' lack of charity reflects their unregenerate state.

5573.title: Heaven is real and Hell is eternal torment
5573.summary: Matthew 25 and Revelation show a real Kingdom of Heaven and a Hell of eternal fiery torment in the presence of the Lamb, against those who call it unjust or mere separation.

5574.title: Everlasting fire, everlasting punishment
5574.summary: Jesus said the wicked go into everlasting fire and punishment, so Hell is a real place, now in the pit of the earth and later the lake of fire.

5612.title: Judas repented, yet went to his own place
5612.summary: Judas repented of betraying innocent blood yet was damned, showing that repenting of a wrong is not believing on Christ, which is why modern versions change repented to remorse.

5629.title: The gospel came in power and in the Holy Ghost
5629.summary: The Thessalonians show the Great Commission bearing fruit, the gospel spreading everywhere within years by the power of the Holy Ghost in those who preached it.

5649.title: Not only saving souls but building them up
5649.summary: Paul's care for the Thessalonians shows that after winning souls we must edify new believers like our own children to walk worthy of God.

5650.theme: Unbelieving Jews a synagogue of Satan
5650.title: Wrath is come upon them to the uttermost
5650.summary: Paul's words that the Jews killed the Lord, please not God and are contrary to all men still describe them today, whatever their origin, as a synagogue of Satan.

5651.title: Souls won, our crown of rejoicing
5651.summary: Every soul we help bring to Christ is our joy and crown at His coming, the gold that remains when our works are tried by fire.

5696.title: Stablished and comforted in tribulation
5696.summary: All Christians will meet persecution, and those without deep roots wither like the stony ground, so we stay in the word and prayer and take comfort in Christ's return.

5697.title: Satan attacks the hope of His coming
5697.summary: Satan pushes preterism, amillennialism, pre-trib rapture and doubts about Heaven, Hell and the preserved word to rob believers of hope and roots, leaving them withered in tribulation.

5768.title: Two offices and God's plan for church planting
5768.summary: The pastoral epistles give two church offices, bishop and deacon, and God's plan of pastor-led local churches training men and planting churches, which denominations and the Bible college system abandoned.

5769.title: The law is good if a man use it lawfully
5769.summary: Paul warns against fables and genealogies but says God's law is good for the lawless and sinners, so it still needs enforcing today against libertarian Christians who take liberty for license.

5784.title: Pray for all men and live peaceably
5784.summary: Believers are to pray for all men and rulers and live peaceably without fear or wrath, through the one Mediator, so their testimony brings others to the truth, with men and women each keeping their God-given roles.

5803.title: Qualifications of bishop and deacon
5803.summary: Churches are to be pastor-led with deacons serving, and both offices require a married man of one wife ruling his house well, sober, not greedy and not a novice.

5804.title: Men established in the mystery of godliness
5804.summary: The offices are for men, never women, holding the mystery of the faith, which Paul defines as the gospel of God manifest in the flesh, with grave and faithful wives.

5825.title: Doctrines of devils: forbidding to marry
5825.summary: The Spirit expressly foretold departures teaching forbidding to marry and abstaining from meats, doctrines of devils later taken up by the Roman Catholic Church.

5826.title: Bodily exercise profiteth little
5826.summary: Every creature is good to eat being sanctified by the word and prayer, and godliness, not the flesh, is what profits, since God is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.

5850.title: Pure religion: widows and the fatherless
5850.summary: God commands care for widows and orphans, families must honour and support their own widows, and the church cares for widows indeed, a duty now largely handed to the state.

5851.title: Saved, faith and damnation in context
5851.summary: Words like saved, faith, damnation, justified and infidel often carry a present or earthly sense in the epistles, and reading them in context guards against twisting verses about salvation.

5852.title: Who is a widow indeed
5852.summary: A widow indeed is over sixty, desolate, trusting God and devoted to good works, while younger widows should not be supported but remarry, lest idleness bring reproach on the church.

5853.title: Double honour and open rebuke of elders
5853.summary: Elders who labour in the word deserve double honour, and accusations against them need witnesses, but those who sin, especially sexually against the young, must be publicly rebuked and put out.

5873.title: Servants honouring masters for a good witness
5873.summary: Scripture repeatedly commands obeying earthly authority and being the best of workers so God's name is not blasphemed, while always keeping God as the higher authority and leaving wrath to Him.

5876.title: The love of money and the good fight of faith
5876.summary: The love of money is the root of all evil, so the man of God flees it, is content with what God gives, and lays hold on eternal life and treasure in heaven.

5877.title: Avoid vain babblings and science falsely so called
5877.summary: The rich are to give freely, and believers entrusted with the gospel should avoid vain disputations with scorners and heretics, which are a bad witness.

5878.theme: Now is the day of salvation
5878.title: To day if ye will hear his voice
5878.summary: God's call and light last only for a time, as the door of the ark was shut, so the unbelieving must repent and believe on Christ today.

5899.title: I know whom I have believed
5899.summary: Paul, in chains, urges Timothy not to be ashamed of the gospel, teaching that predestination is in Christ, not of individual believers, and resting in the assurance that God keeps what we commit to Him.

5944.theme: Enduring hardness as a good soldier
5944.title: Endure hardness as a good soldier of Christ
5944.summary: Timothy is charged to endure as a soldier, athlete and husbandman for the elect's sake, who become elect by believing rather than by Calvinist choosing, and to rightly divide the word against cankerous false teachers.

5945.title: Vessels to honour and to dishonour
5945.summary: In God's great house carnal believers are still saved but earthen vessels, which refutes Lordship salvation and perseverance, and we should sanctify ourselves to be gold and silver vessels.

5946.theme: Vessels meet for the master's use
5946.title: How to become a vessel meet for the master
5946.summary: We sanctify ourselves by fleeing youthful lusts, following righteousness, avoiding foolish questions, and gently teaching those in error so they may come to the truth.

5973.title: All scripture given by inspiration of God
5973.summary: 2 Timothy 3 teaches that all scripture is inspired, preserved and sufficient for doctrine, so independent fundamental Baptist churches drawing doctrine from scripture alone are the only way.

5985.title: A crown of righteousness for all who love His appearing
5985.summary: Paul charges Timothy to preach the word in season and out, and finishes his course assured of the crown of righteousness that all who love Christ's appearing will receive when works are tried.

6003.title: Paul's apostleship and the one voice of scripture
6003.summary: God repeatedly affirmed Paul's apostleship because heretics attack his epistles, yet all 66 books are one word with one voice, and repeated doctrines like the pastoral epistles are given for emphasis.

6004.title: Ordain elders and stop the mouths of deceivers
6004.summary: Titus 1 gives the qualifications for elders who hold fast sound doctrine to convince gainsayers, especially reprobate Judaizers whose fables led to the Roman Catholic Church.

6023.title: Give no occasion for the enemy to blaspheme
6023.summary: Sound doctrine makes believers sober and blameless so the word is not blasphemed, and God chastens His children, as with David, for giving His enemies occasion to blaspheme.

6024.title: Content in our station, humble before God
6024.summary: Servants are to be honest and diligent, content in their station and humble, since God resists the proud, so they may win even their masters to Christ.

6040.title: Not by works of righteousness which we have done
6040.summary: Titus 3 makes clear we are saved by grace alone through faith in Christ alone, and good works are for those who have already believed, to be profitable to others.

6041.title: Reject a heretic after two admonitions
6041.summary: Strivings about the law and genealogies are vain, so after a heretic is shown scripture twice we should reject him rather than argue from pride.

6043.title: Judge doctrine, not another's walk
6043.summary: We should not judge a person's standing with God by his works or sins, but we can judge by his doctrine, and one trusting in anything but the gospel can be counted unsaved.

6059.title: Philemon and Onesimus: brokering forgiveness
6059.summary: Paul's appeal for Onesimus models how believers should forgive one another and help make peace between brethren, remembering what Christ forgave us.

6080.title: If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean
6080.summary: The leper calling on Jesus pictures the gospel: acknowledging our sickness of spirit and calling on Christ in faith today to be made clean.

6095.title: Christ the physician of sinners
6095.summary: Christ forgiving the palsied man's sins proves His deity, and His call to sinners shows all need the physician, made clean by His imputed righteousness, not by their own.

6096.title: The sabbath was made for man
6096.summary: Jesus taught that the sabbath pictured rest in Him and that what defiles is the heart, not outward ritual, a higher standard than the Pharisees' outward show.

6097.title: Sinners called to repentance, the doctor first
6097.summary: When Jesus called sinners to repentance He meant turning from works religion toward God for healing, not cleaning up first; we go to the doctor to be healed.

6098.title: The trap of works religion and faithless religion
6098.summary: Works-based religions keep people trapped in sin by trying to justify themselves, while faithless Sadducee-like religion is equally a trap, and Christ calls men to repent of both.

6120.title: Who is my mother, or my brethren?
6120.summary: Mark 3 shows Mary had other children and that Jesus did not exalt her above any believer, so Marian veneration before images is blasphemy and idolatry.

6134.title: The sower: deep roots in good ground
6134.summary: Jesus used natural things to teach the spiritual, which the natural man cannot discern, and saved believers can be stony or thorny ground unless they grow deep roots in God's word.

6135.title: To him that hath shall more be given
6135.summary: God gives understanding freely to those who receive His word, but from hardened hearts by the wayside He eventually takes the light away.

6136.title: The seed groweth, he knoweth not how
6136.summary: The kingdom grows like sown seed and a mustard tree, God not dictating which seed sprouts, a rebuke of Calvinism and a picture of believers branching out by leading others to Christ.

6138.title: God is just, and God is love
6138.summary: Scoffers who call God cruel for damning imperfect men are fruit of works religion, but God saves by grace through faith all who believe, as a gift that can never be lost.

6195.title: Worshipping God in vain by the traditions of men
6195.summary: Like the Pharisees, the Catholic Church and her daughters leave God's commandments for man-made rituals and seek grace doled out by men.

6196.title: What cometh out of the man defileth him
6196.summary: Sin comes from within the heart, so the believer must walk in the Spirit, the word and prayer to fill the heart with Christ's righteousness rather than the flesh.

6198.theme: Saved by faith, not by blood
6198.title: Even the dogs received the crumbs
6198.summary: Jesus came to take away the sins of the whole world, so salvation is by individual faith and not by flesh and blood, while God judges nations by their collective works.

6217.title: I see men as trees, walking
6217.summary: Those who call Jesus Lord but trust their own works are like the half-healed blind man and Peter, savouring the things of men and blind to the imputed righteousness of Christ.

6234.title: The last shall be first, and hell fire for offenders
6234.summary: Greatness in the kingdom comes from serving the least, those who offend little ones face a hotter hell, and denying hell is a damnable heresy that removes the need for salvation.

6235.title: The fire that never shall be quenched
6235.summary: In Mark 9 Jesus Himself describes hell as literal unquenchable fire in God's presence, not mere annihilation or the grave, which is why sinners need saving.

6253.title: Divorce, the hardness of hearts, and Satan's accusations
6253.summary: Jesus taught that divorce and remarriage is adultery, and normalised divorce is the first step Satan uses to lead a nation into fornication, abortion and the corruption of children.

6262.title: The rich young man and blind Bartimaeus
6262.summary: The rich young man trusted his own righteousness and riches and left unsaved, while blind Bartimaeus called on the Lord for mercy and was made whole by faith.

6265.title: The only requirement to be healed is faith
6265.summary: The rich young man's story does not teach that works or selling everything are required for salvation, since Bartimaeus and others were healed by faith alone.

6284.title: An hundredfold now, with persecutions
6284.summary: The hundredfold promise is fellowship, homes and spiritual family among believers along with persecutions, not the material riches the prosperity false gospel teaches.

6287.title: Prove all things by scripture
6287.summary: False teachers who deny Christ's claims can only fool those who don't know the Bible, so wisdom comes by studying and comparing scripture with scripture, not by debate.

6288.title: Whosoever will be great shall be servant of all
6288.summary: True greatness is in humbly serving others as Christ, who came to minister and promises to serve His faithful servants at His return.

6300.title: The cursed fig tree withered from the roots
6300.summary: The fruitless fig tree pictures Judah, cut off forever for bearing no fruit, which is not replacement theology and refutes the dispensational claim that God is not done with the Jews.

6302.title: Have faith in God and forgive when ye pray
6302.summary: God promises to answer believing prayer, but we must forgive others as He forgave us, since unforgiveness hinders us and God chastens disobedient sons on earth.

6303.title: Meekness as strength against enemies
6303.summary: Like Jesus silencing His tempters, believers should answer enemies with blamelessness and scripture rather than railing, letting their own hypocrisy expose them.

6318.title: Have ye not read this scripture?
6318.summary: Jesus rebuked error with scripture because God gave His word to be plainly understood, and those who claim it needs esoteric interpretation by scholars are liars.

6338.title: Render to Caesar, and to God the things that are God's
6338.summary: The point of Christ's answer is to render to God what is His; a people that does so gets better government, while Judea, refusing to repent, was destroyed.

6360.title: In the resurrection they neither marry
6360.summary: Jesus answers the Sadducees that resurrected saints are like the angels who cannot marry, angels are never called sons of God, and the saints will judge in the millennial kingdom.

6363.title: The greatest commandment and the scribe near the kingdom
6363.summary: Jesus summed the law in loving God and neighbour, both quoted from the Old Testament, and the scribe who humbly sought scripture was near the kingdom.

6365.title: David's Lord at the right hand of God
6365.summary: From Psalm 110 Jesus shows the Christ is not merely David's son but David's Lord, seated at God's right hand, and the vain scribes earn greater condemnation.

6382.title: Evolution versus the testimony of creation
6382.summary: Evolution is unfalsifiable science falsely so-called, while biblical creation, God's testimony, explains the kinds, complexity and origin of nations.

6383.theme: God sets the bounds of nations
6383.title: Evolution undermines the case for nations
6383.summary: Evolution's change-or-die logic justifies race mixing and erasing borders, whereas nations exist and are blessed or destroyed by God's handiwork and judgment.

6384.theme: God sets the bounds of nations
6384.title: No moral case for nations without a Creator
6384.summary: Without a purposeful Creator who set nations and their habitations there is no moral case for preserving a people, as natural selection does not care.

6388.title: Take heed: the end is not yet
6388.summary: In the Olivet discourse Jesus warns that false Christs, wars, disasters and persecution are only the beginning of sorrows and not the sign of His return.

6389.title: He that shall endure unto the end shall be saved
6389.summary: Enduring to the end refers to believers being delivered from persecution, by death or by His return, not to earning spiritual salvation.

6390.theme: After the tribulation, before the wrath
6390.title: The abomination of desolation is the sign
6390.summary: The sign to watch for is the abomination of desolation, then the darkening of sun and moon and Christ's visible return to gather the elect after the great tribulation.

6391.title: This generation shall not pass
6391.summary: This generation means those alive when the signs come to pass, and dispensationalists twist the verse to obscure the plain meaning of the Olivet discourse.

6392.theme: After the tribulation, before the wrath
6392.title: In those days, after that tribulation
6392.summary: Mark 13 plainly places the darkening of the heavens, Christ's coming and the gathering of His elect after the tribulation.

6393.title: Watch ye therefore
6393.summary: Since no man knows the day or hour, believers must watch, stay sober and be faithful stewards so the Lord finds them ready.

6414.title: Peter slept: watch and pray lest ye deny Him
6414.summary: Peter denied Christ after failing to watch and pray, and believers who fall asleep spiritually likewise deny Him, so we must stay vigilant in prayer; the Lord's supper is a symbol, not literal blood.

6415.title: Suffering wrongfully, taking it patiently
6415.summary: Following Christ's example, suffering patiently for doing well is acceptable to God, while bearing punishment for our own faults is only the bare minimum.

6416.title: We slip, but walk in the word daily
6416.summary: Believers make vows and backslide, but walking daily in the word and prayer builds faith so we are not easily tempted and are transformed by the renewing of the mind.

6454.title: He that believeth not shall be damned
6454.summary: Mark 16:16 does not make baptism required for salvation, since the condition is belief and baptism is only the outward sign of a profession of faith.

6474.title: A literal creation about 6,000 years ago
6474.summary: Genesis 1 is a literal account of creation about 6,200 years ago because God who cannot lie says so, and evolution is worship of time, a created thing.

6497.theme: Free will and the free gift
6497.title: Sin entered by choice and so does the free gift
6497.summary: Made in God's image with will, Adam chose to sin and Christ chose to obey, and a free gift cannot be forced but must be received by choice.

6499.theme: Every word of God is pure
6499.title: Yea, hath God said? Satan's oldest trick
6499.summary: Satan's first tactic was casting doubt on God's word, the same strategy behind modern Bible versions, footnotes and scholars who undermine scripture.

6500.title: Fig leaves of our own works
6500.summary: Adam and Eve tried to cover their shame with fig leaves of their own making and then blamed others, as men still do instead of trusting God's covering.

6501.title: Coats of skins: the first promise of Christ
6501.summary: In Genesis 3 God promises the seed who bruises the serpent's head and covers Adam and Eve with skins by shed blood, a picture of Christ's imputed righteousness.

6519.title: The seed of the woman bruises the serpent's head
6519.summary: Revelation 12 fulfils Genesis 3: the devil, cast out, wars against the saints in the great tribulation while Christ, bruised on the heel, comes to crush his head.

6550.title: Man's duty to love his women as Christ
6550.summary: God placed women in men's care, so it is men's God-given duty to love and lead their wives and women with honour, and society collapses when they fail.

6557.title: The chronogenealogies and a young earth
6557.summary: The ages in Genesis 5 and 11 are given literally and, with the generations to Christ, place the earth at about 6,000 years old.

6575.theme: Always saved by grace through faith
6575.title: Noah found grace in the eyes of the Lord
6575.summary: Noah was saved by grace through faith like every believer, the flood picturing Christ's death, burial and resurrection, and the giants were men.

6577.title: The wickedness of man, not bloodlines
6577.summary: The flood shows evil comes from man's own heart, not from foreign bloodlines or hybrids, so all men of one blood have free will and need salvation by faith.

6578.title: Who are the sons of God?
6578.summary: Scripture defines the sons of God as believers who receive Christ and are adopted as joint heirs with Him, from Seth's day to now.

6579.theme: Angels are not sons of God
6579.title: Angels are not sons of God
6579.summary: Scripture says God never called angels His sons and they do not marry, which refutes the doctrine of angel-human hybrids in Genesis 6.

6591.theme: Every word of God is pure
6591.title: The flood is true because the Bible says so
6591.summary: The global flood is true because God's word says so, and believers should answer scoffers with meekness and the faith of Noah.

6606.title: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest
6606.summary: God vowed after the flood to preserve the seasons until the end, so environmental and climate panic is unbiblical.

6615.title: God's covenant with Noah
6615.summary: After the flood God allowed all meat but blood, instituted capital punishment for murder because man is in God's image, and gave the rainbow covenant.

6616.title: The false Talmudic Noahide laws
6616.summary: The Noahide laws are a Talmudic invention meant to subject Gentiles to Jewish rule, and dispensationalism and Judaizers push churches toward this Christless system.

6700.theme: God sets the bounds of nations
6700.title: Babel: God scattered them into nations
6700.summary: At Babel God confounded one-world man-made unity and scattered men into nations by kindred, and the genealogies mark the time from Adam to Christ.

6725.title: God judges nations; Jewish identity is rejecting Christ
6725.summary: God is no respecter of persons in offering salvation but judges nations collectively, and the Jews' identity rests on rejecting Christ, so they are given over as in Romans 1.

6731.title: Not doing nothing: how a nation is healed
6731.summary: A nation is healed not by sedition and outrage but by God's people humbling themselves, praying, obeying, raising godly families and winning souls (2 Chronicles 7:14).

6757.title: God's promises to Abram, not the modern state
6757.summary: God's promise to bless them that bless Abram was personal to him, not to the modern Jewish state, and Abram was saved by calling on the Lord.

6777.theme: The church is the Israel of God
6777.title: To thy seed, which is Christ
6777.summary: The promises to Abraham's seed are fulfilled in Christ, in whom believers inherit the land forever, while Lot pitching his tent toward Sodom warns against choosing worldly ease.

6814.theme: Christ our King and High Priest
6814.title: Melchizedek, a picture of Christ
6814.summary: Melchizedek, priest of the most high God with bread and wine and receiving tithes, pictures or is Christ, showing the patriarchs' faith was always about Jesus.

6815.title: Abram rescues Lot and refuses Sodom's spoils
6815.summary: Abram stayed out of the kings' war, rescued his brother and refused the wicked king's treasure, a pattern for believers defending the righteous without entanglement.

6882.theme: The church is the Israel of God
6882.title: Thy seed as the stars: one promise, one faith
6882.summary: The promise of seed as the stars is fulfilled in Christ and the innumerable redeemed of Revelation 7, not the modern Jew, under one faith in both testaments.

6884.title: He believed, and it was counted for righteousness
6884.summary: Abram's faith in the promised seed was imputed to him for righteousness, and the sacrifices of Genesis 15 pictured Christ's blood offering.

6916.title: Cast out the bondwoman and her son
6916.summary: Ishmael cast out pictures those who seek justification by works of the law, including Talmudic Jews and all works religions, while the children of faith inherit.

6944.theme: The church is the Israel of God
6944.title: Circumcision of the heart
6944.summary: Abraham's circumcision pictured the circumcision of the heart by the Spirit, for a true Jew is one inwardly.

6976.theme: Christ appearing in the Old Testament
6976.title: The Judge of all the earth at Abraham's tent
6976.summary: Comparing scripture, the Lord who ate with Abraham was Christ, since no man has seen the Father and Jesus is the Judge of all the earth.

6992.title: Righteous Lot, the backslidden believer
6992.summary: Lot pictures the saved man taken in by the world, vexed but mired in sin, whose worldly-raised daughters fell into abomination.

7018.title: 2 Thessalonians 2:15 does not overturn scripture
7018.summary: Holding the traditions Paul taught cannot mean secret teachings contradicting scripture, and heretics cherry-pick that verse against God's complete word.

7020.title: The traditions were end-times teaching from scripture
7020.summary: In context, the traditions of 2 Thessalonians 2 were Paul's scriptural teaching on Christ's coming, not hidden doctrines.

7021.title: The pattern of heretical proof texts
7021.summary: Heretics strip verses of context, ignore contradicting scripture and appeal to church fathers, and God sends strong delusion to those who love not the truth.

7022.title: Correct false teachers with love from scripture
7022.summary: Instead of striving in debates, believers should meekly correct error from the misused scripture and pray for those zealous without knowledge, since faith comes by hearing the word.

7030.title: Making the word of none effect by tradition
7030.summary: Jesus in Mark 7 condemned traditions that make God's word of none effect, so any tradition of man contradicting scripture is heresy.

7031.title: Paul reasoned out of the scriptures
7031.summary: Acts 17 shows the apostles preached from the scriptures and the Bereans checked them by scripture, so there were no secret oral traditions contrary to the word.

7033.title: Paul received no gospel from man
7033.summary: Paul received his gospel by revelation, not from men's traditions, and anyone preaching another gospel of works is accursed.

7039.title: Abraham's repeated lie and our struggle with sin
7039.summary: Even Abraham repeatedly sinned from fear, so believers should judge humbly, knowing God saves by grace and chastens His sons for their good.

7040.title: Not everything a man says in scripture is so
7040.summary: Abraham's claim that Sarah was his half-sister was said under duress, so we must test men's statements in the Bible by context and scripture.

7073.title: Justified by faith, free to serve righteousness
7073.summary: Romans teaches justification by faith as with Abraham, and believers freed from the law become willing servants of righteousness rather than continuing in sin.

7075.title: Rome denies the liberty that is in Christ
7075.summary: The Roman Catholic Church and her daughters keep people yoked to works for justification, the error of Cain, denying the liberty of Christ.

7082.title: The rosary is pagan vain repetition
7082.summary: The rosary is of pagan origin and its repetitive prayers break Jesus' command against vain repetitions.

7083.title: Rome edited the second commandment
7083.summary: Rome removed the commandment against graven images and split the tenth, so its use of idols breaks God's law.

7116.title: God will provide Himself a lamb
7116.summary: Abraham's offering of Isaac on Moriah pictures Christ in every detail, from the wood carried uphill to the ram in the thorns.

7117.title: The cleansing birds, cedar, scarlet and hyssop
7117.summary: Isaac's offering and the Leviticus 14 cleansing ritual both picture Christ, showing all the law pointed to Him.

7132.title: Sarah's life an allegory of believing Israel
7132.summary: Sarah's life pictures faithful Old Testament Israel saved by faith in the promise, while Hagar and Ishmael picture Israel after the flesh, cast out.

7133.title: Do ye not hear the law? The bondwoman and the free
7133.summary: Paul's Hagar-Sarah allegory warns that adding works of the law to faith puts men under bondage, while salvation is God's free gift that cannot be lost.

7157.title: Trust the Lord to bring your Rebekah
7157.summary: As Abraham's servant was led to Rebekah, young believers should trust the Lord to bring them a spouse and live godly rather than seek where they should not.

7166.theme: The church is the Israel of God
7166.title: If ye be Christ's, then are ye Abraham's seed
7166.summary: Abraham's blessing passed to Isaac and is fulfilled in Christ, so all believers are Abraham's seed and heirs according to the promise.

7191.title: Esau sold his birthright for pottage
7191.summary: Carnal Christians who trade their blessings for fleshly pleasures are like Esau, keeping sonship but losing blessings here and in the kingdom.

7192.title: Not replacement but rejection
7192.summary: Like Esau the Jews despised their birthright by rejecting Christ and became spiritual Edom, which is rejection, not replacement, the younger receiving the blessing by faith.

7193.title: Dispensationalists selling the birthright to spiritual Edom
7193.summary: God did not replace Edom; the Christ-rejecting Jews are spiritual Edom, and dispensationalists who honour them sell their own birthright for man's approval.

7254.theme: The house of God and the tithe
7254.title: Bethel, the pillar and the house of God
7254.summary: Jacob's Bethel introduces the house of God, which scripture calls the church, the pillar of truth, and Jacob vowed a tithe there.

7255.title: His sons are always His sons
7255.summary: Unlike Esau or the prodigal trying to work off debt, believers are adopted sons sealed and preserved by God, which is the theme of the whole Bible.

7308.theme: Children a heritage of the LORD
7308.title: Children are a blessing; trust God with the womb
7308.summary: Marriage is to one wife for life, children are God's reward, and birth control and abortion are grave sins of not trusting God who opens and shuts the womb.

7344.theme: Christ appearing in the Old Testament
7344.title: Jacob wrestled with God face to face
7344.summary: The man who wrestled Jacob was Christ, who renamed him Israel, a picture of being born again.

7439.title: Jacob have I loved, Esau have I hated
7439.summary: The hatred of Esau refers to the later wicked nation of Edom, not to Esau himself, who God blessed and who was saved by faith, against the Calvinist reading.

7443.title: Covenants have conditions: the fall of Edom
7443.summary: God gave Edom a promised land then destroyed it for its iniquities, showing covenants have conditions, against the Zionist claim that God's land promise is unconditional.

7445.theme: The church is the Israel of God
7445.title: Jews Falsely So-Called Are Spiritually Edom
7445.summary: There is no ethnic role in salvation, so the Jews who reject Christ are spiritually Edom while believers are spiritually Israel heirs of a better country.

7461.title: The World Hates an Evil Report of Sin
7461.summary: As Joseph's brothers hated him for his evil report, the world hates faithful Christians because preaching against sin exposes their deeds.

7462.title: Joseph's Brothers Hated Him as the Jews Hated Christ
7462.summary: The brothers' resentment of Joseph's prophetic dreams mirrors the Jews' hatred of Christ, of whom Moses and the prophets wrote.

7486.title: Onan's Sin Was Denying Seed to His Brother
7486.summary: Onan was slain not for the act itself but for refusing to raise seed to his dead brother as God's law required, a passage commonly misread.

7511.title: Work Faithfully Like Joseph Even in Prison
7511.summary: Saved workers should be like Joseph, working hard and doing right in every condition, trusting God to bless their hand.

7597.title: Pure Words Purified Seven Times
7597.summary: Psalm 12 teaches that God's pure, preserved words cut off the proud lips of the wicked, and he notes the KJV as the seventh major English translation.

7713.title: Revelation Is Written to Reveal
7713.summary: Revelation is a blessing written to reveal, and its late first century authorship by John undoes the preterist claim that it was fulfilled in 70 AD.

7715.title: Revelation Is About Christ, Not Geopolitics
7715.summary: Like all scripture Revelation centres on Christ, explains its own mysteries so it is not too hard to read, and names churches plural, not a universal church.

7743.title: The Fall Feasts Picture the Second Coming
7743.summary: The fall feasts of Leviticus 23 picture Christ's second coming, and their commanded rest from all work pictures salvation by grace without works.

7772.title: Ephesus Left Its First Love
7772.summary: The first love the Ephesian church left was winning souls, and a church that stops preaching the gospel to every creature will have its candlestick removed.

7773.title: The Synagogue of Satan Persecuted Smyrna
7773.summary: Christ calls those who say they are Jews and are not the synagogue of Satan, which Zionist and dispensational churches fail to see.

7774.title: The Doctrine of Balaam in Pergamos
7774.summary: The doctrine of Balaam is leading God's people into fornication and idol sacrifices to bring His judgment on them, as at Baalpeor, and Pergamos suffered it.

7776.title: Thyatira Suffered That Woman Jezebel to Teach
7776.summary: Thyatira's troubles came from suffering a woman to teach against 1 Timothy 2:12, and Christ chastens such backslidden servants severely though they are saved.

7808.title: Blotted Out, Never Added to the Book of Life
7808.summary: All are born into the book of life and are only blotted out through unbelief, reprobation or unpardonable sin; no one is ever added to it.

7809.theme: The church is the Israel of God
7809.title: The Key of David Opens and Shuts
7809.summary: Christ opens the door of salvation that none can shut and also shuts in reprobation, and those who say they are Jews but deny Christ are liars, spiritually Edom.

7811.title: The Lukewarm Church of Laodicea
7811.summary: Christ rebukes comfortable lukewarm churches out of love, and the church ages teaching that we live in a Laodicean age is false and breeds complacency.

7835.theme: After the tribulation, before the wrath
7835.title: Heresies Drawn from Revelation 4
7835.summary: Revelation 4:1 is John alone in the spirit, not a pre-trib rapture, and the chapter gives no support to Catholic vain repetitions, soul sleep or gnosticism.

7893.title: The White Horse Rider Is the Antichrist
7893.summary: The first seal's rider on a white horse is the Antichrist imitating Christ, a man of war seeking one world government, the messiah Talmudic Judaism awaits.

7895.theme: After the tribulation, before the wrath
7895.title: The Seals Line Up with Matthew 24
7895.summary: The seals track the Olivet discourse, and the sixth seal's darkened sun and moon mark the gathering of the elect immediately after the tribulation.

7896.theme: After the tribulation, before the wrath
7896.title: The Secret Pre-Trib Rapture Is Heresy
7896.summary: The day of the Lord is visible to all and begins the wrath, so a secret rapture sparing the saints the tribulation is a wicked heresy.

7920.title: The 144,000 Are Not Modern Jews
7920.summary: The 144,000 sealed from the tribes are not modern Jews but likely Old Testament saints saved by faith and sent to earth during the wrath.

7921.theme: After the tribulation, before the wrath
7921.title: The Multitude Appears After the Sixth Seal
7921.summary: The raptured multitude appears in heaven after the six seals and before the seventh seal's wrath, in sequence, proving a post-trib, pre-wrath rapture.

7922.theme: After the tribulation, before the wrath
7922.title: They Came Out of Great Tribulation
7922.summary: The elder says the multitude came out of great tribulation, which puts to bed pre-trib, post-wrath, preterist and millennial errors.

7945.title: The Trumpets Are Wrath, Not Tribulation
7945.summary: The trumpet judgments are God's wrath fuelled by the saints' prayers and cannot be confused with the tribulation, and Revelation is meant to reveal.

7946.title: The Plagues of Egypt Picture God's Wrath
7946.summary: The plagues of Egypt picture the wrath poured out in the trumpets, as prophecy often has dual fulfilment.

7976.theme: The wrath is of God, not Satan
7976.title: Abaddon Is the Destroyer Serving God
7976.summary: Abaddon is not Satan but the destroying angel of death who serves God, as in the Passover and at Ornan's threshingfloor.

7977.theme: The wrath is of God, not Satan
7977.title: The Army of the Sixth Trumpet Is God's
7977.summary: As Joel 2 shows, the horsemen of the sixth trumpet are God's army, for Satan is the prince of this world, not the ruler of hell.

7979.title: Still They Repented Not
7979.summary: Even in His wrath God seeks repentance, yet hardened men refuse, and believers should study the timing themselves rather than lean on others.

8011.theme: After the tribulation, before the wrath
8011.title: Daniel 12 and Revelation 10 Are Bookends
8011.summary: Daniel 12 and Revelation 10 show the same vision from both ends of the seven years, from the tribulation and deliverance to the finishing of the mystery.

8041.title: No Promise of a Third Temple
8041.summary: Scripture promises no third temple after 70 AD; Scofield invented this teaching, and any sacrifices offered by Christ-rejecting Jews would be an abomination.

8045.title: The Days of Vengeance on Judea
8045.summary: In Luke 21 Jesus speaks of the Jews as they and them in the days of vengeance, matching the Gentiles treading Jerusalem in Revelation 11.

8055.title: The Woman's Seed and the Serpent's Seed
8055.summary: Revelation 12 fulfils Genesis 3: Eve's seed is Christ who crushes Satan, while Satan's seed are the reprobate who persecute those who overcome by the blood.

8057.title: Satan's Seed Is Spiritual
8057.summary: The seed of Satan is not physical descent from Eve but spiritual: those who do his lusts and multiply by recruiting, grooming and perversion.

8058.title: The Woman Is Allegorical Eve
8058.summary: The woman of Revelation 12 is neither Mary nor modern Israel but best fits an allegorical Eve, closing the Genesis prophecy.

8060.title: The Woman Is Not Modern Israel
8060.summary: Scofield's teaching that the woman is Israel twists Joseph's dream to prop up a pre-trib rapture and Jewish kingdom, while Revelation mentions Jews only as persecutors.

8061.title: Revelation 12 Tells It Three Times
8061.summary: Revelation intentionally repeats events, and chapter 12 tells the same vision three times, which helps in understanding it.

8084.title: Faith Over Fear in Great Tribulation
8084.summary: Facing the beast's war on the saints, believers must trust God rather than their own preparations, love the brethren, and look to Him to provide in the wilderness.

8085.theme: After the tribulation, before the wrath
8085.title: Pre-Trib Gives a False Security
8085.summary: Early Christians faced death unafraid, but the pre-trib rapture and other end-times errors give a false comfort that leaves people unready.

8099.title: The Beast Promises Peace and Safety
8099.summary: The beast rises in the beginning of sorrows as a counterfeit Christ promising peace and safety, then blames believers and makes war on the saints.

8100.title: The False Prophet and the Image of the Beast
8100.summary: The second beast is the false prophet of a one world religion who makes a speaking image of the Antichrist, so believers should flee idolatry now.

8101.title: The Mark of the Beast
8101.summary: The mark of the beast is how the beast system separates believers for slaughter, but that war is cut short by the sixth seal and the rapture.

8103.theme: After the tribulation, before the wrath
8103.title: Pre-Trib Dispensationalism Undone by Scripture
8103.summary: The rapture is immediately after the tribulation, not before, and dispensationalism rests on the heresy that Jews are saved by bloodline rather than by grace through faith.

8104.title: The Feet of Iron and Clay
8104.summary: The iron mixed with clay in Daniel 2 is the remnant of Rome that clings to power today, from which the ten kingdoms will give the beast his power.

8105.title: Miry Clay Mingled with Iron
8105.summary: The miry clay mixed with iron may be false believers, chiefly the Catholic Church and her harlot daughters seeking political power.

8155.title: The Everlasting Gospel Preached Even in Wrath
8155.summary: The 144,000 likely minister during the wrath, and the angel with the everlasting gospel shows a God who offers grace to all, not the god of Calvin.

8156.theme: After the tribulation, before the wrath
8156.title: Recap of the End Times Timeline
8156.summary: He sets out the full order of events: sorrows, the beast, the Great Tribulation, rapture after the tribulation, then the 144,000 and three and a half years of wrath.

8163.title: Hell Is Real, Eternal Torment
8163.summary: Hell is a real place of eternal torment in the presence of the Lamb, not the grave, annihilation or Satan's kingdom, so some must be saved with fear.

8165.title: The Winepress of the Wrath of God
8165.summary: As Abel's blood cried from the ground, the innocent blood of the martyrs brings the grapes of wrath to ripeness.

8194.title: The Song of Moses and the Song of the Lamb
8194.summary: The song of Moses is likely Deuteronomy 32, prophesying wrath on Israel for rejecting the Rock, and the song of the Lamb is the new song of Revelation 5.

8222.title: The Vials Align with the Trumpets
8222.summary: The seven vials parallel the seven trumpets in the same wrath period, poured on the damned who harden their hearts rather than repent.

8224.title: Watch and Keep Thy Garments
8224.summary: Christ comes as a thief only to the unwatchful, and anyone can know today they are saved by faith alone in His finished work.

8225.title: Revelation Tells the End Twice
8225.summary: Comparing chapter 11 with 16 shows Revelation retells the end times twice, and preterism and other systems fail because they do not make the Bible the final authority.

8244.title: The Spirit of Babylon Is Whoredom
8244.summary: Babel was the first works-based one world religion, and its spirit of idolatry is spiritual whoredom, which gives the context for the whore of Babylon.

8247.title: The Whore and the Bride
8247.summary: The whore and the Lamb's bride are set in contrast: trusting idols, rites or works is spiritual adultery against a jealous God.

8264.title: The Fall of Babylon the Great City
8264.summary: Babylon is destroyed last in the wrath, and the seat of Babylon is always some nation embodying its spirit, which today looks like the United States.

8302.title: The Names of Christ in Revelation
8302.summary: Revelation gives many names of Christ, including the Word of God, as He rides out after the marriage supper to the short battle of Armageddon.

8354.title: The White Throne Judgment of the Dead
8354.summary: The great white throne judges the damned blotted out of the book of life, who go to the lake of fire, and only faith in Christ escapes that judgment.

8503.title: Made a Little Lower Than the Angels
8503.summary: Christ the Creator was made flesh and tasted death for every man, freeing believers from the devil's power of death and the fear of it.

8549.theme: Now is the day of salvation
8549.title: Today If Ye Will Hear His Voice
8549.summary: As unbelief kept Israel out of the promised land, unbelief keeps men from God's rest, which is entered now by faith while the call lasts.

8550.title: Ceasing from Our Own Works
8550.summary: Entering God's rest means ceasing from our own works, since adding works shows unbelief in His finished work; Christ is our Sabbath.

8552.theme: Christ our King and High Priest
8552.title: Come Boldly to the Throne of Grace
8552.summary: Because Christ is a High Priest tempted like us, believers go boldly to God through Him alone, with no need of saints, Mary or sacraments.

8568.title: One Gospel to Romans and Hebrews
8568.summary: Paul teaches the same gospel to Gentiles and Hebrews from what each knew, and the 66 books are to be taken as one testimony rather than cherry picked.

8597.title: Hebrews 6 Does Not Teach Losing Salvation
8597.summary: Hebrews 6 is twisted by the unlearned to teach that salvation can be lost, but God has sworn nothing can separate the believer from His love.

8615.theme: Christ our King and High Priest
8615.title: A Priest After the Order of Melchisedec
8615.summary: Christ is a High Priest after the order of Melchisedec, greater than Levi, and the change of priesthood disannulled the law of Moses.

8633.title: I Regarded Them Not
8633.summary: Hebrews 8:9 shows the Jews broke the covenant and God regarded them not, so salvation was never by bloodline but always by faith.

8634.title: The Tabernacle and the Better Covenant
8634.summary: Under the new covenant God's Spirit and law dwell in believers, making each a temple and priest with direct access through Christ.

8660.title: Christ Offered Once to Bear Our Sins
8660.summary: Substitutionary atonement teaches that Christ's blood, pictured by the old sacrifices, sealed the better testament and removed the veil between God and man.

8661.title: Adding Works Crucifies Christ Afresh
